source.text: וֶאֱלִישָׁע֙ הַנָּבִ֔יא קָרָ֕א לְאַחַ֖ד מִבְּנֵ֣י הַנְּבִיאִ֑ים וַיֹּ֨אמֶר ל֜וֹ חֲגֹ֣ר מָתְנֶ֗יךָ וְ֠קַח פַּ֣ךְ הַשֶּׁ֤מֶן הַזֶּה֙ בְּיָדֶ֔ךָ וְלֵ֖ךְ רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And Elisha the prophet called to one of [the] sons of the prophets and said to him, Gird up your loins and take [the] flask of the oil this in your hand and go [to] Ramoth-gilead.

en.L: And Elisha the prophet called one of the sons of the prophets and said to him, "Gird up your loins, and take this flask of oil in your hand, and go to Ramoth-gilead.
en.B: Elisha the prophet called one of the company of prophets and said to him, "Tuck your robe into your belt, take this flask of oil with you, and go to Ramoth-gilead.
en.R: Elisha the prophet called a man from the group of prophets. He said to him, "Get ready to travel. Take this small jar of olive oil with you and go to the town of Ramoth-gilead.

es.L: Y el profeta Eliseo llamó a uno de los hijos de los profetas y le dijo: «Ciñe tus lomos, y toma en tu mano este frasco de aceite, y ve a Ramot de Galaad.
es.B: El profeta Eliseo llamó a uno de los discípulos de los profetas y le dijo: «Recógete la túnica en el cinturón, toma contigo este frasco de aceite y ve a Ramot de Galaad.
es.R: El profeta Eliseo llamó a un hombre del grupo de profetas. Le dijo: «Prepárate para el viaje. Lleva contigo este frasquito de aceite de oliva y ve a la ciudad de Ramot de Galaad.

fr.L: Et Élisée le prophète appela l’un des fils des prophètes et lui dit : « Ceins tes reins, prends cette fiole d’huile dans ta main, et va à Ramoth de Galaad.
fr.B: Élisée le prophète appela l’un des disciples des prophètes et lui dit : « Remonte ton vêtement dans ta ceinture, prends avec toi cette fiole d’huile, et va à Ramoth de Galaad.
fr.R: Élisée le prophète a appelé un homme du groupe de prophètes. Il lui a dit : « Prépare-toi à partir. Prends avec toi cette petite fiole d’huile d’olive, et va dans la ville de Ramoth de Galaad.

sw.L: Elisha nabii akamwita mmoja wa wana wa manabii, akamwambia, "Jifunge viuno vyako, uchukue chupa hii ya mafuta mkononi mwako, uende Ramoth-gileadi.
sw.B: Elisha nabii akamwita mmoja wa kundi la manabii, akamwambia, "Jifunge mshipi tayari kwa safari, chukua chupa hii ya mafuta pamoja nawe, uende Ramoth-gileadi.
sw.R: Elisha nabii akamwita mtu mmoja wa kundi la manabii. Akamwambia, "Jiandae kwa safari. Chukua kichupa hiki cha mafuta ya zeituni, uende katika mji wa Ramoth-gileadi.

vi.L: Nhà tiên tri Ê-li-sê gọi một người trong các con trai của các nhà tiên tri và bảo người ấy: "Hãy thắt lưng, cầm bình dầu này trong tay và đi đến Ra-mốt ở Ga-la-át.
vi.B: Nhà tiên tri Ê-li-sê gọi một người trong đoàn tiên tri và bảo: "Con hãy giắt áo vào thắt lưng, đem bình dầu này theo và đi đến Ra-mốt ở Ga-la-át.
vi.R: Nhà tiên tri Ê-li-sê gọi một người trong đoàn tiên tri đến. Ông bảo người ấy: "Con hãy chuẩn bị lên đường. Đem theo hũ dầu ô-liu nhỏ này và đi đến thành Ra-mốt ở Ga-la-át.

ko.L: 그리고 예언자 엘리사가 예언자의 아들들 가운데 하나를 불러 그에게 말했다. "네 허리를 동이고, 이 기름병을 네 손에 들고 길르앗 라못으로 가거라.
ko.B: 예언자 엘리사가 예언자 무리 가운데 한 사람을 불러 그에게 말했다. "옷자락을 허리띠에 질러 넣고, 이 기름병을 가지고 길르앗 라못으로 가거라.
ko.R: 예언자 엘리사가 예언자 무리 가운데 한 사람을 불러 말했다. "길 떠날 준비를 하여라. 올리브기름이 든 이 작은 병을 가지고 길르앗 라못 성으로 가거라.

pt.L: E Eliseu, o profeta, chamou um dos filhos dos profetas e lhe disse: "Cinja os lombos, tome este frasco de óleo na sua mão e vá a Ramote-Gileade.
pt.B: O profeta Eliseu chamou um dos homens do grupo de profetas e lhe disse: "Prenda a túnica no cinto, leve este frasco de óleo e vá a Ramote-Gileade.
pt.R: O profeta Eliseu chamou um homem do grupo de profetas e lhe disse: "Prepare-se para viajar. Leve este pequeno frasco de azeite e vá até a cidade de Ramote-Gileade.

decisions.choice: sons of the prophets: a member of a band of prophets
decisions.reason: "Sons of" means members of a group, not children. These prophets lived and worked together, and Elisha led them as Elijah had before him (2:3, 15; 4:38; 6:1).

decisions.choice: gird up your loins: get ready to move quickly
decisions.reason: Men wore long robes. Before running or hard work they pulled up the lower part and tucked it into the belt (1 Kings 18:46; 2 Kings 4:29). The order means "go at once, and go fast".

decisions.choice: the flask of oil: a small vessel of anointing oil
decisions.reason: The word names a small jar or flask, the same word used for the oil Samuel poured on Saul (1 Samuel 10:1). Pouring oil on a man's head set him apart as king (1 Samuel 16:13; 1 Kings 1:39).

decisions.choice: Ramoth-gilead: the frontier town where Israel's army faced Aram
decisions.reason: Ramoth-gilead, east of the Jordan, was fought over by Israel and Aram (1 Kings 22:3). Joram king of Israel had been wounded there and had gone back to Jezreel, leaving his commanders with the army (8:28-29; 9:14-15).

decisions.choice: sons of the prophets (Literal); company of prophets (Balanced); group of prophets (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2:3: the wording follows the settled terms for Samuel and Kings.

decisions.choice: tuck your robe into your belt (Balanced); get ready to travel (Readable); small jar of olive oil (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the idiom; Balanced says what the man did, as in 1 Kings 18:46, and Readable gives its point. Readable also says what kind of oil and vessel it was.

decisions.choice: Elisha calls the young prophet "con"
decisions.reason: The young man is one of the prophets who live under Elisha's leadership and call him "thầy" (6:1).

decisions.choice: um dos filhos dos profetas (L); um dos homens do grupo de profetas (B); um homem do grupo de profetas (R)
decisions.reason: The community of prophets (m1) keeps the wording 1 Kings 20:35 sets for the book in Portuguese, as 2:3 does: "filhos dos profetas" at Literal, where the meaning note explains it, and "grupo de profetas" at Balanced and Readable, as the English says "company" and "group". Elisha speaks to the man with "você", as one man to another.

decisions.choice: Cinja os lombos (L); Prenda a túnica no cinto (B); Prepare-se para viajar (R); frasco de óleo (L, B), pequeno frasco de azeite (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture (m2) in the old Portuguese phrase "cingir os lombos"; Balanced says what the man did with his robe and Readable gives its point, as the English does. The flask (m3) keeps the words of 1 Samuel 10:1 in Portuguese, where Samuel anoints Saul from the same small vessel: "frasco de óleo" at Literal and Balanced, "pequeno frasco de azeite" at Readable.

source.text: וּבָ֖אתָ שָׁ֑מָּה וּרְאֵֽה־שָׁ֠ם יֵה֨וּא בֶן־יְהוֹשָׁפָ֜ט בֶּן־נִמְשִׁ֗י וּבָ֨אתָ֙ וַהֲקֵֽמֹתוֹ֙ מִתּ֣וֹךאֶחָ֔יו וְהֵבֵיאתָ֥ אֹת֖וֹ חֶ֥דֶר בְּחָֽדֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will come there and see there Jehu son of Jehoshaphat son of Nimshi, and you will go in and make him rise from among his brothers and bring him [into a] room within a room.

en.L: And when you come there, look there for Jehu son of Jehoshaphat son of Nimshi, and go in and make him get up from among his brothers, and bring him into an inner room.
en.B: When you get there, look for Jehu son of Jehoshaphat son of Nimshi. Go in, have him get up from among his fellow officers, and take him into an inner room.
en.R: When you get there, look for Jehu son of Jehoshaphat and grandson of Nimshi. Go in and call him away from the other officers. Take him to a room where you can be alone.

es.L: Y cuando llegues allí, busca allí a Jehú hijo de Josafat hijo de Nimsi, y entra y haz que se levante de entre sus hermanos, y llévalo a un cuarto dentro de otro cuarto.
es.B: Cuando llegues allí, busca a Jehú hijo de Josafat hijo de Nimsi. Entra, haz que se levante de entre sus compañeros oficiales y llévalo a un cuarto interior.
es.R: Cuando llegues allí, busca a Jehú, hijo de Josafat y nieto de Nimsi. Entra y llámalo aparte de los demás oficiales. Llévalo a un cuarto donde puedan estar a solas.

fr.L: Et quand tu y arriveras, cherche là Jéhu fils de Josaphat fils de Nimshi ; entre, fais-le lever du milieu de ses frères, et emmène-le dans une chambre intérieure.
fr.B: Quand tu y seras, cherche Jéhu, fils de Josaphat, fils de Nimshi. Entre, fais-le se lever du milieu de ses compagnons d’armes et emmène-le dans une pièce retirée.
fr.R: Quand tu seras arrivé, cherche Jéhu, fils de Josaphat et petit-fils de Nimshi. Entre et appelle-le pour qu’il quitte les autres officiers. Emmène-le dans une pièce où vous serez seuls.

sw.L: Utakapofika huko, mtafute huko Yehu mwana wa Yehoshafati mwana wa Nimshi, uingie, umwinue kutoka katikati ya ndugu zake, umpeleke katika chumba cha ndani.
sw.B: Utakapofika huko, mtafute Yehu mwana wa Yehoshafati mwana wa Nimshi. Ingia, umwondoe katikati ya maafisa wenzake, umpeleke katika chumba cha ndani.
sw.R: Utakapofika huko, mtafute Yehu mwana wa Yehoshafati, mjukuu wa Nimshi. Ingia umwite atoke katikati ya maafisa wenzake. Mpeleke katika chumba mtakapokuwa peke yenu.

vi.L: Khi đến đó, hãy tìm Giê-hu con trai Giô-sa-phát, con trai Nim-si, rồi đi vào, bảo người đứng dậy khỏi giữa các anh em mình và dẫn người vào một phòng bên trong.
vi.B: Khi đến nơi, hãy tìm Giê-hu con trai Giô-sa-phát, cháu Nim-si. Hãy đi vào, mời người ra khỏi chỗ các bạn đồng ngũ, và đưa người vào một phòng kín bên trong.
vi.R: Khi đến nơi, hãy tìm Giê-hu con trai Giô-sa-phát, cháu Nim-si. Hãy vào gọi người ra khỏi chỗ các sĩ quan khác. Hãy đưa người vào một phòng riêng.

ko.L: 그리고 네가 그곳에 이르거든, 거기서 님시의 아들 여호사밧의 아들 예후를 찾아보아라. 그리고 들어가서 그를 그의 형제들 가운데서 일어나게 하여 골방으로 데리고 들어가거라.
ko.B: 그곳에 이르거든 님시의 손자이며 여호사밧의 아들인 예후를 찾아라. 들어가서 그를 동료 지휘관들 가운데서 불러내어 안쪽 방으로 데리고 가거라.
ko.R: 그곳에 가거든 님시의 손자이며 여호사밧의 아들인 예후를 찾아라. 들어가서 그를 다른 지휘관들에게서 불러내어, 둘이서만 있을 수 있는 방으로 데리고 가거라.

pt.L: E, [quando] você chegar lá, procure ali Jeú, filho de Josafá, filho de Ninsi; e entre, faça-o levantar-se do meio dos seus irmãos e leve-o a um quarto dentro de outro quarto.
pt.B: Quando chegar lá, procure Jeú, filho de Josafá, filho de Ninsi. Entre, faça-o levantar-se do meio dos seus companheiros de armas e leve-o a um quarto interior.
pt.R: Quando chegar lá, procure Jeú, filho de Josafá e neto de Ninsi. Entre e chame-o para longe dos outros oficiais. Leve-o a um quarto onde vocês possam ficar a sós.

decisions.choice: Jehu son of Jehoshaphat son of Nimshi: Jehu's father and grandfather
decisions.reason: Jehu's father was Jehoshaphat, not the king of Judah with that name, and Nimshi was his grandfather. Elsewhere Jehu is often called simply "son of Nimshi" (verse 20; 1 Kings 19:16), naming him by the better-known ancestor.

decisions.choice: his brothers: his fellow officers
decisions.reason: "Brothers" here means comrades, the other commanders of the army sitting with him (verse 5), not his family.

decisions.choice: a room within a room: an inner, private room
decisions.reason: The doubled word means a room inside the house, away from others (1 Kings 20:30; 22:25). The anointing was to be done in secret.

decisions.choice: fellow officers (Balanced); the other officers (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of "brothers" in this setting (m2).

decisions.choice: and grandson of Nimshi
decisions.reason: Readable makes plain that Nimshi was Jehu's grandfather, since verse 20 calls Jehu "son of Nimshi".

decisions.choice: un cuarto dentro de otro cuarto
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "room within a room"; Balanced and Readable say what it means, a private inner room (m3).

decisions.choice: "cháu Nim-si"
decisions.reason: The second "son of" names Jehu's grandfather (m1); Vietnamese says "cháu" at Balanced and Readable, while Literal keeps the Hebrew's two "con trai".

decisions.choice: "예후", "님시", "여호사밧" for Jehu, Nimshi and Jehoshaphat; Literal keeps the Hebrew order "son of ... son of", Balanced and Readable say "grandson of Nimshi"
decisions.reason: The forms of the terms note; Korean "손자이며 ... 아들인" makes the two generations clear, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "골방" at Literal for "a room within a room"
decisions.reason: "골방" is the Korean word for a small inner room, which the meaning decision describes (m3).

decisions.choice: Jeú, filho de Josafá, filho de Ninsi
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "Jeú" as the shared list for Kings has it, the same form as the prophet of 1 Kings 16:1 in Portuguese. His father (m1) has the same name as the king of Judah, "Josafá", the form Brazilian readers know; he is a different man, as the meaning note says. "Ninsi" can be written as it stands. Readable says "neto", as the English says "grandson".

decisions.choice: irmãos (L); companheiros de armas (B); os outros oficiais (R); um quarto dentro de outro quarto (L), um quarto interior (B)
decisions.reason: "Brothers" here are his fellow officers (m2): Literal keeps "irmãos"; Balanced says "companheiros de armas", the Portuguese phrase for men who serve together in an army. Literal keeps the doubled word for the inner room (m3) as "um quarto dentro de outro quarto", which Portuguese can say plainly.

source.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ֤ פַךְ־הַשֶּׁ֨מֶן֙ וְיָצַקְתָּ֣ עַל־רֹאשׁ֔וֹ וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ כֹּֽה־אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה מְשַׁחְתִּ֥יךָֽ לְמֶ֖לֶךְ אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּפָתַחְתָּ֥ הַדֶּ֛לֶת וְנַ֖סְתָּה וְלֹ֥א תְחַכֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will take [the] flask of the oil and pour on his head and say, Thus says Yahweh, I have anointed you to king over Israel; and you will open the door and flee and not wait.

en.L: And take the flask of oil and pour [it] on his head and say, 'Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: I anoint you king over Israel.' Then open the door and flee, and do not wait."
en.B: Then pour the flask of oil over his head and say, '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: I anoint you king over Israel.' After that, open the door and run; do not wait."
en.R: Then pour the oil on his head and say, 'This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: I am making you king over Israel.' Then open the door and run away. Do not stay there."

es.L: Y toma el frasco de aceite y derráma[lo] sobre su cabeza y di: “Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Te unjo como rey sobre Israel”. Luego abre la puerta y huye, y no te detengas».
es.B: Luego derrama el frasco de aceite sobre su cabeza y dile: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: Te unjo como rey de Israel”. Después abre la puerta y huye; no esperes».
es.R: Luego derrámale el aceite sobre la cabeza y dile: “Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Te hago rey de Israel”. Después abre la puerta y vete corriendo. No te quedes allí».

fr.L: Et prends la fiole d’huile, verse-[la] sur sa tête et dis : “Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Je t’oins roi sur Israël.” Puis ouvre la porte et enfuis-toi, et n’attends pas. »
fr.B: Puis verse la fiole d’huile sur sa tête et dis : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Je t’oins roi d’Israël.” Ensuite, ouvre la porte et sauve-toi, sans attendre. »
fr.R: Ensuite verse l’huile sur sa tête et dis : “Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Je fais de toi le roi d’Israël.” Puis ouvre la porte et sauve-toi. Ne reste pas là. »

sw.L: Uchukue chupa ya mafuta, uimimine juu ya kichwa chake, useme, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Nimekupaka mafuta uwe mfalme juu ya Israeli.' Kisha fungua mlango, ukimbie, wala usikawie."
sw.B: Kisha mimina mafuta ya chupa hiyo juu ya kichwa chake, useme, 'Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Nakupaka mafuta uwe mfalme juu ya Israeli.' Baada ya hapo fungua mlango, ukimbie; usingoje."
sw.R: Kisha mimina mafuta juu ya kichwa chake, useme, 'Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Ninakufanya mfalme juu ya Israeli.' Kisha fungua mlango, ukimbie. Usikae huko."

vi.L: Hãy lấy bình dầu đổ trên đầu người và nói: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Ta xức dầu cho ngươi làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.' Rồi hãy mở cửa chạy trốn, đừng chần chừ."
vi.B: Rồi hãy đổ bình dầu trên đầu người và nói: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Ta xức dầu cho ngươi làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.' Sau đó hãy mở cửa mà chạy; đừng nán lại."
vi.R: Rồi hãy đổ dầu trên đầu người và nói: 'Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Ta lập ngươi làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.' Sau đó hãy mở cửa chạy đi. Đừng ở lại đó."

ko.L: 그리고 기름병을 가져다가 그의 머리에 붓고 말하여라. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하십니다. 내가 너에게 기름을 부어 이스라엘의 왕으로 세운다.' 그리고 문을 열고 도망치고, 머물러 있지 마라."
ko.B: 그리고 기름병의 기름을 그의 머리에 붓고 말하여라. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하십니다. 내가 너에게 기름을 부어 이스라엘의 왕으로 세운다.' 그런 다음 문을 열고 달아나거라. 머뭇거리지 마라."
ko.R: 그리고 그 기름을 그의 머리에 붓고 말하여라. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀은 이것입니다. 내가 너를 이스라엘의 왕으로 세운다.' 그런 다음 문을 열고 달아나거라. 거기 머물지 마라."

pt.L: E tome o frasco de óleo e [o] derrame sobre a cabeça dele e diga: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Eu te unjo rei sobre Israel.' Então abra a porta e fuja, e não espere."
pt.B: Depois derrame o óleo do frasco sobre a cabeça dele e diga: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Eu te unjo rei sobre Israel.' Em seguida abra a porta e fuja; não espere."
pt.R: Depois derrame o azeite na cabeça dele e diga: 'É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: Eu estou fazendo de ti o rei de Israel.' Depois abra a porta e fuja. Não fique lá."

decisions.choice: I anoint you: the anointing takes effect as the words are spoken
decisions.reason: The verb is in the form for a completed act, used when a speaker brings something about by saying it. Yahweh, through the prophet, makes Jehu king at that moment.

decisions.choice: I anoint you king over Israel: the charge given to Elijah carried out
decisions.reason: At Horeb Yahweh told Elijah to anoint Jehu son of Nimshi as king over Israel (1 Kings 19:16-17). Elisha now has it done through one of the prophets.

decisions.choice: open the door and flee: leave at once
decisions.reason: The messenger is not to stay to talk or explain. To be found anointing a rival king in the army's camp was dangerous, and the haste also leaves Jehu alone with the word of Yahweh.

decisions.choice: Thus says the LORD (Literal); The LORD says this (Balanced); This is what the LORD says (Readable)
decisions.reason: The prophetic formula is worded as everywhere in Samuel and Kings.

decisions.choice: I am making you king
decisions.reason: Readable says what anointing does here, since "anoint" is not an everyday word.

decisions.choice: Te hago rey
decisions.reason: Readable says what the anointing does here, as the English does; Literal and Balanced keep "ungir", the word of the Samuel note.

decisions.choice: "nimekupaka mafuta" (Literal); "nakupaka mafuta" (Balanced); "ninakufanya mfalme" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Anointing follows the Samuel terms ("kumpaka mafuta"); Readable says what the anointing does, as English does.

decisions.choice: The messenger formula in 합쇼체 ("말씀하십니다"), since the young prophet will speak to Jehu, a commander; God's words keep 해라체
decisions.reason: The young man addresses a superior; God's own words are given as God speaks them.

decisions.choice: Assim diz o SENHOR (L, B), É isto que o SENHOR diz (R); Eu te unjo (tu)
decisions.reason: The messenger formula keeps the wording 1 Kings 13:2 sets for the whole book. The LORD's words speak to Jehu with "tu" ("te"), as God speaks to one person, while Elisha's own orders to the young prophet stay with "você"; the present "unjo" says that the anointing takes effect as the words are spoken (m1), and Readable says what it does, as the English does.

source.text: וַיֵּ֧לֶךְ הַנַּ֛עַר הַנַּ֥עַר הַנָּבִ֖יא רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And went the young man, the young man the prophet, [to] Ramoth-gilead.

en.L: And the young man, the young man the prophet, went to Ramoth-gilead.
en.B: So the young man, the prophet's servant, went to Ramoth-gilead.
en.R: So the young man, the prophet's helper, went to Ramoth-gilead.

es.L: Y fue el joven, el joven del profeta, a Ramot de Galaad.
es.B: Así que el joven, el criado del profeta, fue a Ramot de Galaad.
es.R: Así que el joven ayudante del profeta fue a Ramot de Galaad.

fr.L: Et le jeune homme, le jeune homme du prophète, alla à Ramoth de Galaad.
fr.B: Le jeune homme, le serviteur du prophète, partit donc pour Ramoth de Galaad.
fr.R: Le jeune homme, l’aide du prophète, est donc allé à Ramoth de Galaad.

sw.L: Kijana, kijana yule nabii, akaenda Ramoth-gileadi.
sw.B: Basi yule kijana, mtumishi wa nabii, akaenda Ramoth-gileadi.
sw.R: Basi yule kijana, msaidizi wa nabii, akaenda Ramoth-gileadi.

vi.L: Người thanh niên, người thanh niên của nhà tiên tri, đi đến Ra-mốt ở Ga-la-át.
vi.B: Vậy người thanh niên, đầy tớ của nhà tiên tri, đi đến Ra-mốt ở Ga-la-át.
vi.R: Vậy người thanh niên phụ tá của nhà tiên tri đi đến Ra-mốt ở Ga-la-át.

ko.L: 그리고 그 젊은이, 곧 그 예언자의 젊은이가 길르앗 라못으로 갔다.
ko.B: 그래서 그 젊은이, 곧 예언자의 종이 길르앗 라못으로 갔다.
ko.R: 그래서 예언자를 돕는 그 젊은이가 길르앗 라못으로 갔다.

pt.L: E o jovem, o jovem, o profeta, foi a Ramote-Gileade.
pt.B: Então o jovem, o servo do profeta, foi a Ramote-Gileade.
pt.R: Então o jovem, o ajudante do profeta, foi até Ramote-Gileade.

decisions.choice: the young man, the young man the prophet: the prophet's young servant
alternatives: the young man, the young prophet
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats "the young man" and then adds "the prophet". It most likely means "the young man, the servant of the prophet", that is, Elisha's young helper (compare 5:20). It could also mean "the young man, the young prophet", one of the company of prophets (verse 1).

decisions.choice: the prophet's servant (Balanced); the prophet's helper (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the more likely sense (m1); Literal keeps the repeated words.

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֗א וְהִנֵּ֨ה שָׂרֵ֤י הַחַ֨יִל֙ יֹֽשְׁבִ֔ים וַיֹּ֕אמֶר דָּבָ֥ר לִ֛י אֵלֶ֖יךָ הַשָּׂ֑ר וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יֵהוּא֙ אֶל־מִ֣י מִכֻּלָּ֔נוּ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלֶ֥יךָ הַשָּֽׂר׃

records.literal_gloss: And he came, and behold, [the] commanders of the army [were] sitting; and he said, A word [is] to me for you, the commander; and said Jehu, For whom of all of us? And he said, For you, the commander.

en.L: And he came, and look, the commanders of the army [were] sitting [there]. And he said, "I have a word for you, commander." And Jehu said, "For which of all of us?" And he said, "For you, commander."
en.B: When he arrived, the commanders of the army were sitting together. He said, "I have a message for you, commander." Jehu asked, "For which one of us?" He answered, "For you, commander."
en.R: When he got there, the army commanders were sitting together. He said, "Sir, I have a message for you." "For which one of us?" Jehu asked. "For you, sir," he answered.

es.L: Y llegó, y he aquí que los jefes del ejército [estaban] sentados. Y dijo: «Tengo una palabra para ti, jefe». Y Jehú dijo: «¿Para cuál de todos nosotros?». Y él dijo: «Para ti, jefe».
es.B: Cuando llegó, los jefes del ejército estaban sentados juntos. Él dijo: «Tengo un mensaje para ti, jefe». Jehú le preguntó: «¿Para cuál de nosotros?». Él respondió: «Para ti, jefe».
es.R: Cuando llegó, los jefes del ejército estaban sentados juntos. Dijo: «Señor, tengo un mensaje para ti». «¿Para cuál de nosotros?», preguntó Jehú. «Para ti, señor», respondió él.

fr.L: Et il arriva, et voici, les chefs de l’armée [étaient] assis. Et il dit : « J’ai une parole pour toi, chef. » Et Jéhu dit : « Pour lequel de nous tous ? » Et il dit : « Pour toi, chef. »
fr.B: Quand il arriva, les chefs de l’armée étaient assis ensemble. Il dit : « J’ai un message pour toi, chef. » Jéhu demanda : « Pour lequel d’entre nous ? » Il répondit : « Pour toi, chef. »
fr.R: Quand il est arrivé, les chefs de l’armée étaient assis ensemble. Il a dit : « Commandant, j’ai un message pour toi. » « Pour lequel d’entre nous ? » a demandé Jéhu. « Pour toi, commandant », a-t-il répondu.

sw.L: Akafika, na tazama, wakuu wa jeshi [walikuwa] wameketi. Akasema, "Nina neno kwako, ewe mkuu." Yehu akasema, "Kwa yupi kati yetu sote?" Akasema, "Kwako wewe, ewe mkuu."
sw.B: Alipofika, wakuu wa jeshi walikuwa wameketi pamoja. Akasema, "Nina ujumbe kwako, mkuu." Yehu akauliza, "Kwa yupi kati yetu?" Akajibu, "Kwako wewe, mkuu."
sw.R: Alipofika huko, makamanda wa jeshi walikuwa wameketi pamoja. Akasema, "Bwana, nina ujumbe kwako." Yehu akauliza, "Kwa yupi kati yetu?" Akajibu, "Kwako wewe, bwana."

vi.L: Người ấy đến, và kìa, các tướng chỉ huy quân đội đang ngồi [đó]. Người ấy nói: "Thưa tướng quân, tôi có một lời cho ông." Giê-hu nói: "Cho ai trong tất cả chúng tôi?" Người ấy nói: "Cho ông, thưa tướng quân."
vi.B: Khi người ấy đến nơi, các tướng chỉ huy quân đội đang ngồi với nhau. Người ấy nói: "Thưa tướng quân, tôi có một sứ điệp cho ông." Giê-hu hỏi: "Cho ai trong chúng tôi?" Người ấy đáp: "Thưa tướng quân, cho ông."
vi.R: Khi người ấy đến nơi, các tướng chỉ huy quân đội đang ngồi với nhau. Người ấy nói: "Thưa ông, tôi có một sứ điệp cho ông." Giê-hu hỏi: "Cho ai trong chúng tôi?" Người ấy đáp: "Thưa ông, cho ông."

ko.L: 그리고 그가 와서 보니, 보라, 군대의 지휘관들이 앉아 [있었다]. 그리고 그가 말했다. "지휘관님, 제가 지휘관님께 드릴 말씀이 있습니다." 그러자 예후가 말했다. "우리 모두 가운데 누구에게 말이오?" 그러자 그가 말했다. "지휘관님께 드릴 말씀입니다."
ko.B: 그가 도착해 보니, 군대 지휘관들이 함께 앉아 있었다. 그가 말했다. "장군님, 장군님께 전할 말씀이 있습니다." 예후가 물었다. "우리 가운데 누구에게 말이오?" 그가 대답했다. "장군님께 전할 말씀입니다."
ko.R: 그가 그곳에 가 보니, 군대 지휘관들이 함께 앉아 있었다. 그가 말했다. "장군님, 장군님께 전할 말씀이 있습니다." 예후가 물었다. "우리 가운데 누구에게 말이오?" 그가 대답했다. "바로 장군님께 전할 말씀입니다."

pt.L: E ele chegou, e eis que os comandantes do exército [estavam] sentados [ali]. E ele disse: "Tenho uma palavra para o senhor, comandante." E Jeú disse: "Para qual de todos nós?" E ele disse: "Para o senhor, comandante."
pt.B: Quando ele chegou, os comandantes do exército estavam sentados juntos. Ele disse: "Tenho uma mensagem para o senhor, comandante." Jeú perguntou: "Para qual de nós?" Ele respondeu: "Para o senhor, comandante."
pt.R: Quando chegou lá, os comandantes do exército estavam sentados juntos. Ele disse: "Tenho uma mensagem para o senhor." "Para qual de nós?", perguntou Jeú. "Para o senhor", ele respondeu.

decisions.choice: the commanders of the army: the officers leading Israel's troops
decisions.reason: They were holding Ramoth-gilead against Hazael king of Aram while King Joram was away (verse 14).

decisions.choice: commander: a respectful address
decisions.reason: The young man speaks to the group without naming anyone, so Jehu asks whom he means. His answer singles Jehu out in front of the others.

decisions.choice: a word: a message
decisions.reason: The word can mean a matter, a word or a message; here it is the message from Yahweh (verse 6).

decisions.choice: sir
decisions.reason: Readable uses the everyday polite form of address in place of "commander".

decisions.choice: "Thưa tướng quân" (L, B); "Thưa ông" (R)
decisions.reason: A respectful address to an officer (m2), with "thưa"; Readable says "ông", as the English says "sir".

decisions.choice: The young man addresses Jehu as "지휘관님" (L) and "장군님" (B, R) in 합쇼체; Jehu answers in 하오체
decisions.reason: The respectful address the meaning decision describes (m2); Jehu speaks to a stranger with courtesy.

decisions.choice: o senhor, comandante (L, B); o senhor (R)
decisions.reason: The young man speaks up to an army commander, so he uses "o senhor", as people do to a superior (m2). Readable drops "comandante" where the English says "sir", since "o senhor" already carries that respect.

source.text: וַיָּ֨קָם֙ וַיָּבֹ֣א הַבַּ֔יְתָה וַיִּצֹ֥ק הַשֶּׁ֖מֶן אֶל־רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ כֹּֽה־אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מְשַׁחְתִּ֧יךָֽ לְמֶ֛לֶךְ אֶל־עַ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And he arose and went into the house, and he poured the oil on his head and said to him, Thus says Yahweh [the] God of Israel, I have anointed you to king over [the] people of Yahweh, over Israel.

en.L: And he got up and went into the house, and he poured the oil on his head and said to him, "Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel: I anoint you king over the people of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, over Israel.
en.B: Jehu got up and went into the house. The young man poured the oil on his head and said to him, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, says this: I anoint you king over the people of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, over Israel.
en.R: Jehu got up and went into the house with him. The young man poured the oil on Jehu's head and said, "This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, says: I am making you king over Israel, the people who belong to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y se levantó y entró en la casa, y él derramó el aceite sobre su cabeza y le dijo: «Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel: Te unjo como rey sobre el pueblo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, sobre Israel.
es.B: Jehú se levantó y entró en la casa. El joven le derramó el aceite sobre la cabeza y le dijo: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, dice esto: Te unjo como rey sobre el pueblo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, sobre Israel.
es.R: Jehú se levantó y entró con él en la casa. El joven le derramó el aceite sobre la cabeza y le dijo: «Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel: Te hago rey de Israel, el pueblo que pertenece {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et il se leva et entra dans la maison, et il versa l’huile sur sa tête et lui dit : « Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël : Je t’oins roi sur le peuple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, sur Israël.
fr.B: Jéhu se leva et entra dans la maison. Le jeune homme lui versa l’huile sur la tête et lui dit : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, dit ceci : Je t’oins roi sur le peuple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, sur Israël.
fr.R: Jéhu s’est levé et il est entré avec lui dans la maison. Le jeune homme a versé l’huile sur la tête de Jéhu et il a dit : « Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël : Je fais de toi le roi d’Israël, le peuple qui appartient {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Akainuka, akaingia nyumbani, naye akamimina mafuta juu ya kichwa chake, akamwambia, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, asema hivi: Nimekupaka mafuta uwe mfalme juu ya watu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, juu ya Israeli.
sw.B: Yehu akainuka, akaingia ndani ya nyumba. Yule kijana akamimina mafuta juu ya kichwa chake, akamwambia, "Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, asemavyo: Nakupaka mafuta uwe mfalme juu ya watu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, juu ya Israeli.
sw.R: Yehu akainuka, akaingia ndani ya nyumba pamoja naye. Yule kijana akamimina mafuta juu ya kichwa cha Yehu, akasema, "Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, analosema: Ninakufanya mfalme juu ya Israeli, watu walio mali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Giê-hu đứng dậy đi vào nhà, và người ấy đổ dầu trên đầu Giê-hu và nói với ông: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán thế này: Ta xức dầu cho ngươi làm vua trên dân của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, trên Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Giê-hu đứng dậy đi vào nhà. Người thanh niên đổ dầu trên đầu ông và nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán như vầy: Ta xức dầu cho ngươi làm vua trên dân của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, trên Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Giê-hu đứng dậy đi vào nhà với người ấy. Người thanh niên đổ dầu trên đầu Giê-hu và nói: "Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán: Ta lập ngươi làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, là dân thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 일어나 집 안으로 들어갔다. 그러자 그가 그의 머리에 기름을 붓고 그에게 말했다. "이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하십니다. 내가 너에게 기름을 부어 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 백성, 곧 이스라엘의 왕으로 세운다.
ko.B: 예후가 일어나 집 안으로 들어갔다. 그 젊은이가 예후의 머리에 기름을 붓고 말했다. "이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하십니다. 내가 너에게 기름을 부어 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 백성 이스라엘의 왕으로 세운다.
ko.R: 예후가 일어나 그와 함께 집 안으로 들어갔다. 그 젊은이가 예후의 머리에 기름을 붓고 말했다. "이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀은 이것입니다. 내가 너를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 백성인 이스라엘의 왕으로 세운다.

pt.L: E ele se levantou e entrou na casa, e derramou o óleo sobre a cabeça dele e lhe disse: "Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel: Eu te unjo rei sobre o povo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, sobre Israel.
pt.B: Jeú se levantou e entrou na casa. O jovem derramou o óleo sobre a cabeça dele e lhe disse: "Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel: Eu te unjo rei sobre o povo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, sobre Israel.
pt.R: Jeú se levantou e entrou na casa com ele. O jovem derramou o azeite na cabeça de Jeú e disse: "É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, diz: Eu estou fazendo de ti o rei de Israel, o povo que pertence {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.

decisions.choice: he got up and went into the house: Jehu
decisions.reason: The one who gets up is Jehu, called away from the others (verse 2); the young man then pours the oil. The Hebrew does not change the name of the subject.

decisions.choice: the people of Yahweh, over Israel: Israel still belongs to Yahweh
decisions.reason: The prophet's words go beyond what Elisha told him to say (verse 3). They remind Jehu that the kingdom he will rule is Yahweh's people, though its kings had led it to worship Baal.

decisions.choice: I anoint you: as in verse 3
decisions.reason: The anointing takes effect as Yahweh's words are spoken.

decisions.choice: The young man poured
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name who does each act, since the Hebrew "he" changes from Jehu to the young man (m1).

decisions.choice: king over Israel, the people who belong to the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable puts the familiar name first and explains "the people of the LORD".

decisions.choice: "기름을 부어 ... 왕으로 세운다" for "I anoint you king" (present: the anointing takes effect now)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note for anointing; the present tense follows the meaning decision (m1 of verse 3).

decisions.choice: God calls Jehu "ngươi" at every level
decisions.reason: Yahweh appoints Jehu as the instrument of his judgment on the house of Ahab (verse 7), a king who later does not walk in his law (10:31); he is not addressed as a servant who walks with God, so "ngươi" stays at every level, as for Jeroboam in 1 Kings 11:31.

source.text: וְהִ֨כִּיתָ֔ה אֶת־בֵּ֥ית אַחְאָ֖ב אֲדֹנֶ֑יךָ וְנִקַּמְתִּ֞י דְּמֵ֣י׀עֲבָדַ֣י הַנְּבִיאִ֗ים וּדְמֵ֛י כָּל־עַבְדֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מִיַּ֥ד אִיזָֽבֶל׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will strike down [the] house of Ahab your master, and I will avenge [the] blood of my slaves the prophets and [the] blood of all [the] slaves of Yahweh from [the] hand of Jezebel.

en.L: And you will strike down the house of Ahab your master, and I will avenge the blood of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} slaves the prophets and the blood of all the slaves of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, from the hand of Jezebel.
en.B: You are to strike down the house of your master Ahab, and so I will avenge on Jezebel the blood of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants the prophets, and of all who serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: You will destroy the family of Ahab, your master. In this way I will punish Jezebel for killing {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants the prophets and all the other servants of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y herirás a la casa de Acab tu señor, y yo vengaré la sangre de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos los profetas, y la sangre de todos los siervos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, de la mano de Jezabel.
es.B: Destruirás a la casa de tu señor Acab, y así vengaré en Jezabel la sangre de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos los profetas y de todos los que sirven {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Acabarás con la familia de Acab, tu señor. Así castigaré a Jezabel por haber matado a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos los profetas y a todos los demás siervos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et tu frapperas la maison d’Achab, ton maître, et je vengerai le sang de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} esclaves les prophètes, et le sang de tous les esclaves {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, de la main de Jézabel.
fr.B: Tu dois frapper la maison de ton maître Achab, et ainsi je vengerai sur Jézabel le sang de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} serviteurs les prophètes, et de tous ceux qui servent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Tu détruiras la famille d’Achab, ton maître. Ainsi je punirai Jézabel d’avoir tué {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} serviteurs les prophètes et tous les autres serviteurs {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nawe utaipiga nyumba ya Ahabu bwana wako, nami nitalipiza kisasi damu ya watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} manabii, na damu ya watumishi wote wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mkononi mwa Yezebeli.
sw.B: Utaiangamiza nyumba ya bwana wako Ahabu, nami hivyo nitamlipiza Yezebeli kisasi cha damu ya watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} manabii, na ya wote wanaomtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Utaiangamiza jamaa ya Ahabu, bwana wako. Kwa njia hiyo nitamwadhibu Yezebeli kwa kuwaua watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} manabii na watumishi wengine wote wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Ngươi sẽ đánh hạ nhà A-háp, chủ ngươi, và Ta sẽ báo thù máu của các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là các nhà tiên tri, và máu của tất cả các đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, khỏi tay Giê-sa-bên.
vi.B: Ngươi phải đánh hạ nhà A-háp, chủ ngươi, và như vậy Ta sẽ báo thù Giê-sa-bên về máu của các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là các nhà tiên tri, cùng máu của tất cả những người phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Ngươi sẽ tiêu diệt gia đình A-háp, chủ ngươi. Như vậy Ta sẽ trừng phạt Giê-sa-bên vì đã giết các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là các nhà tiên tri và tất cả những đầy tớ khác của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 너는 네 주인 아합의 집을 쳐야 한다. 그리하여 내가 내 종들인 예언자들의 피와 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 모든 종들의 피를 이세벨의 손에서 갚겠다.
ko.B: 너는 네 주인 아합의 집안을 쳐야 한다. 그리하여 내 종 예언자들의 피와 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기는 모든 사람의 피를 이세벨에게 갚겠다.
ko.R: 너는 네 주인 아합의 집안을 멸망시켜야 한다. 이렇게 해서 나는 이세벨이 내 종 예언자들과 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 다른 모든 종들을 죽인 죄를 벌하겠다.

pt.L: E ferirás a casa de Acabe, teu senhor, e eu vingarei o sangue dos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} escravos, os profetas, e o sangue de todos os escravos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, da mão de Jezabel.
pt.B: Deverás ferir a casa do teu senhor Acabe, e assim eu vingarei em Jezabel o sangue dos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} servos, os profetas, e de todos os que servem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.R: Destruirás a família de Acabe, o teu senhor. Assim castigarei Jezabel por ter matado os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} servos, os profetas, e todos os outros servos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

decisions.choice: you will strike down: a charge as well as a prediction
decisions.reason: The verb form can foretell what Jehu will do or tell him what he must do. In this commission it is both.

decisions.choice: the house of Ahab: Ahab's family line, his dynasty
decisions.reason: "House" means the royal family. Ahab was dead (1 Kings 22:37), but his son Joram was king and his widow Jezebel still had power.

decisions.choice: the blood of my servants the prophets ... from the hand of Jezebel: the prophets she killed
decisions.reason: Jezebel had killed the prophets of Yahweh (1 Kings 18:4, 13; 19:10), and she had Naboth put to death (1 Kings 21:8-15). Yahweh will demand their blood back from her, that is, punish her for their deaths.

decisions.choice: I will avenge: Yahweh speaks again in the first person
decisions.reason: The prophet speaks Yahweh's words as Yahweh's own. Jehu's sword is the means; the vengeance is Yahweh's.

decisions.choice: slaves (Literal); servants (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The word for servant follows the settled rule: "slave" at Literal, "servant" at Balanced and Readable. Here it names those who belong to Yahweh and serve him.

decisions.choice: avenge on Jezebel (Balanced); punish Jezebel for killing (Readable)
decisions.reason: "From the hand of" means "from the one responsible". Balanced and Readable say plainly that Jezebel shed the blood.

decisions.choice: siervos (every level)
decisions.reason: The Psalms note has God's servants as "siervo" at every level in Spanish (only French keeps "esclave" at Literal), so Spanish says "siervos" here where the English Literal says "slaves".

decisions.choice: "watumishi" at every level
decisions.reason: Those who belong to the LORD and serve him are "watumishi" at every level, as God's "my servant" is in the Swahili Samuel drafts, where English Literal says "slaves".

decisions.choice: "종" for God's slaves/servants at every level
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note for *ʿeved* used of God's servants.

decisions.choice: "nô lệ" (L); "đầy tớ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English: *ʿeved* is slave at Literal and servant at Balanced and Readable, as for "my servant David".

decisions.choice: escravos (L); servos (B, R); ferirás (L, B), destruirás (R)
decisions.reason: The word for those who serve the LORD is "escravo" at Literal and "servo" at Balanced and Readable, as the Old Testament terms set it and 1 Kings 8:23 in Portuguese. The future "ferirás" keeps both senses of the verb, a prediction and a charge (m1); Balanced makes the charge plain with "deverás". The LORD still speaks to Jehu with "tu".

source.text: וְאָבַ֖ד כָּל־בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב וְהִכְרַתִּ֤י לְאַחְאָב֙ מַשְׁתִּ֣ין בְּקִ֔יר וְעָצ֥וּר וְעָז֖וּב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And will perish all [the] house of Ahab, and I will cut off to Ahab one urinating against a wall, and shut up and left in Israel.

en.L: And the whole house of Ahab will perish, and I will cut off from Ahab [everyone] who urinates against a wall, both bond and free in Israel.
en.B: The whole house of Ahab will perish. From Ahab I will cut off every male in Israel, whether bond or free.
en.R: All of Ahab's family will die. I will destroy every man and boy in Ahab's family in Israel, whether slave or free.

es.L: Y perecerá toda la casa de Acab, y cortaré de Acab al que orina contra la pared, tanto esclavo como libre en Israel.
es.B: Toda la casa de Acab perecerá. Exterminaré de Acab a todo varón en Israel, sea esclavo o libre.
es.R: Toda la familia de Acab morirá. Acabaré con todos los hombres y niños de la familia de Acab en Israel, sean esclavos o libres.

fr.L: Et toute la maison d’Achab périra, et je retrancherai d’Achab quiconque urine contre un mur, l’esclave comme l’homme libre en Israël.
fr.B: Toute la maison d’Achab périra. Je retrancherai d’Achab tout mâle en Israël, esclave ou libre.
fr.R: Toute la famille d’Achab mourra. Je ferai disparaître tous les hommes et tous les garçons de la famille d’Achab en Israël, qu’ils soient esclaves ou libres.

sw.L: Nyumba yote ya Ahabu itaangamia, nami nitamkatilia mbali Ahabu [kila] akojoaye ukutani, aliyefungwa na aliyeachwa huru katika Israeli.
sw.B: Nyumba yote ya Ahabu itaangamia. Nitamkatilia mbali Ahabu kila mwanamume katika Israeli, akiwa mtumwa au huru.
sw.R: Jamaa yote ya Ahabu itakufa. Nitamwangamiza kila mwanamume na mvulana wa jamaa ya Ahabu katika Israeli, akiwa mtumwa au huru.

vi.L: Cả nhà A-háp sẽ bị tiêu diệt, và Ta sẽ diệt khỏi A-háp mọi kẻ tiểu tiện vào tường, cả người nô lệ lẫn người tự do trong Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Cả nhà A-háp sẽ bị tiêu diệt. Ta sẽ diệt khỏi A-háp mọi người nam trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, dù là nô lệ hay tự do.
vi.R: Cả gia đình A-háp sẽ chết hết. Ta sẽ tiêu diệt mọi người đàn ông và con trai trong gia đình A-háp ở Y-sơ-ra-ên, dù là nô lệ hay người tự do.

ko.L: 그리고 아합의 온 집이 망할 것이다. 그리고 내가 아합에게서 벽에 소변보는 자는, 이스라엘에서 매인 자나 놓인 자나 모두 끊어 버리겠다.
ko.B: 아합의 온 집안이 망할 것이다. 나는 아합의 집안에서 남자는 종이든 자유인이든 이스라엘에서 모두 끊어 버리겠다.
ko.R: 아합의 집안은 모두 죽을 것이다. 나는 이스라엘에 있는 아합의 집안 남자들을 어른이든 아이든, 종이든 자유인이든 모두 없애 버리겠다.

pt.L: E toda a casa de Acabe perecerá, e eliminarei de Acabe [todo] o que urina na parede, o preso e o livre em Israel.
pt.B: Toda a casa de Acabe perecerá. Eliminarei de Acabe todo homem em Israel, seja escravo, seja livre.
pt.R: Toda a família de Acabe vai morrer. Vou destruir todos os homens e meninos da família de Acabe em Israel, escravos ou livres.

decisions.choice: the same sentence as on Jeroboam's and Ahab's houses
decisions.reason: These are the words Ahijah spoke against Jeroboam (1 Kings 14:10) and Elijah against Ahab (1 Kings 21:21). Jehu is the one who will carry them out.

decisions.choice: one who urinates against a wall: a male
decisions.reason: The coarse phrase means every male, from the boy upward, as in 1 Samuel 25:22 and 1 Kings 14:10; 21:21.

decisions.choice: shut up and left: everyone, of every kind
decisions.reason: The meaning of the pair is not certain. It may mean slave and free, those under restraint and those at liberty, or minors under care and adults. In every reading it means all without exception (1 Kings 14:10; 21:21).

decisions.choice: every male (Balanced); every man and boy (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 21:21: Balanced and Readable give the plain sense of the coarse idiom (m2), and Literal keeps its picture. No gender setting is used, because only males are meant.

decisions.choice: bond and free (Literal, Balanced); slave or free (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 21:21; the footnote gives the other possible senses (m3).

decisions.choice: al que orina contra la pared (Literal); a todo varón (Balanced); a todos los hombres y niños (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the coarse Hebrew picture; Balanced and Readable give its plain sense (m2). No gender setting, since only males are meant.

decisions.choice: "mọi kẻ tiểu tiện vào tường"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture for a male (m2) in a word that is plain without being coarse; Balanced and Readable give its meaning.

decisions.choice: Literal keeps "벽에 소변보는 자" and "매인 자나 놓인 자나"; Balanced and Readable say "남자" and "종이든 자유인이든"
alternatives: the plain sense at Literal too
decisions.reason: The English Literal keeps the Hebrew pictures, which the meaning decisions explain (m2, m3).

decisions.choice: o que urina na parede (L), todo homem (B), todos os homens e meninos (R); o preso e o livre (L), escravo ou livre (B, R)
decisions.reason: The sentence on Ahab's house (m1) keeps, word for word at each level, the Portuguese 1 Kings 14:10 sets for the whole book on Jeroboam's house, so the reader hears the same judgment repeated. Literal keeps the coarse picture (m2); Balanced and Readable give its sense, with no gender setting, since only males are meant.

source.text: וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ אֶת־בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֔ב כְּבֵ֖ית יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־נְבָ֑ט וּכְבֵ֖ית בַּעְשָׁ֥א בֶן־אֲחִיָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will make [the] house of Ahab like [the] house of Jeroboam son of Nebat and like [the] house of Baasha son of Ahijah.

en.L: And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam son of Nebat and like the house of Baasha son of Ahijah.
en.B: I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam son of Nebat and like the house of Baasha son of Ahijah.
en.R: I will do to Ahab's family what I did to the families of Jeroboam son of Nebat and of Baasha son of Ahijah.

es.L: Y haré la casa de Acab como la casa de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, y como la casa de Baasa hijo de Ahías.
es.B: Haré con la casa de Acab como con la casa de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat y la casa de Baasa hijo de Ahías.
es.R: Haré con la familia de Acab lo mismo que hice con las familias de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat y de Baasa hijo de Ahías.

fr.L: Et je rendrai la maison d’Achab semblable à la maison de Jéroboam fils de Nebath, et à la maison de Baésha fils d’Ahiya.
fr.B: Je rendrai la maison d’Achab semblable à la maison de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, et à la maison de Baésha, fils d’Ahiya.
fr.R: Je ferai à la famille d’Achab ce que j’ai fait aux familles de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, et de Baésha, fils d’Ahiya.

sw.L: Nami nitaifanya nyumba ya Ahabu kama nyumba ya Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati, na kama nyumba ya Baasha mwana wa Ahiya.
sw.B: Nitaifanya nyumba ya Ahabu kama nyumba ya Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati na kama nyumba ya Baasha mwana wa Ahiya.
sw.R: Nitaitendea jamaa ya Ahabu kama nilivyozitendea jamaa za Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati na Baasha mwana wa Ahiya.

vi.L: Ta sẽ làm cho nhà A-háp giống như nhà Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát và như nhà Ba-ê-sa con trai A-hi-gia.
vi.B: Ta sẽ làm cho nhà A-háp giống như nhà Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát và nhà Ba-ê-sa con trai A-hi-gia.
vi.R: Ta sẽ làm cho gia đình A-háp như Ta đã làm cho gia đình Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát và gia đình Ba-ê-sa con trai A-hi-gia.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 아합의 집을 느밧의 아들 여로보암의 집처럼, 아히야의 아들 바아사의 집처럼 만들겠다.
ko.B: 나는 아합의 집안을 느밧의 아들 여로보암의 집안처럼, 아히야의 아들 바아사의 집안처럼 만들겠다.
ko.R: 나는 느밧의 아들 여로보암의 집안과 아히야의 아들 바아사의 집안에 한 것처럼 아합의 집안에도 하겠다.

pt.L: E farei a casa de Acabe como a casa de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, e como a casa de Baasa, filho de Aías.
pt.B: Tornarei a casa de Acabe igual à casa de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, e à casa de Baasa, filho de Aías.
pt.R: Farei com a família de Acabe o que fiz com as famílias de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, e de Baasa, filho de Aías.

decisions.choice: the house of Jeroboam, the house of Baasha: two royal families wiped out
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 21:22: Baasha killed Jeroboam's whole family (1 Kings 15:29), and Zimri killed Baasha's (1 Kings 16:11-12). Ahab's line will end the same way.

decisions.choice: I will do to Ahab's family what I did to
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 21:22: Readable states the comparison as an action.

source.text: וְאֶת־אִיזֶ֜בֶל יֹאכְל֧וּ הַכְּלָבִ֛ים בְּחֵ֥לֶק יִזְרְעֶ֖אל וְאֵ֣ין קֹבֵ֑ר וַיִּפְתַּ֥ח הַדֶּ֖לֶת וַיָּנֹֽס׃

records.literal_gloss: And Jezebel will eat the dogs in [the] plot of ground of Jezreel, and there is no one burying; and he opened the door and fled.

en.L: And Jezebel the dogs will eat in the plot of ground of Jezreel, and there will be none to bury [her]." And he opened the door and fled.
en.B: As for Jezebel, the dogs will eat her on the plot of ground at Jezreel, and no one will bury her." Then he opened the door and ran.
en.R: Dogs will eat Jezebel's body on the land at Jezreel, and no one will bury her." Then the young man opened the door and ran away.

es.L: Y a Jezabel la comerán los perros en la parcela de Jezreel, y no habrá quien [la] sepulte». Y abrió la puerta y huyó.
es.B: En cuanto a Jezabel, los perros se la comerán en la parcela de Jezreel, y nadie la sepultará». Luego abrió la puerta y huyó.
es.R: Los perros se comerán el cuerpo de Jezabel en el campo de Jezreel, y nadie la sepultará». Después el joven abrió la puerta y se fue corriendo.

fr.L: Et Jézabel, les chiens la mangeront dans le champ de Jizreël, et il n’y aura personne pour [l’]enterrer. » Et il ouvrit la porte et s’enfuit.
fr.B: Quant à Jézabel, les chiens la mangeront dans le champ de Jizreël, et personne ne l’enterrera. » Puis il ouvrit la porte et se sauva.
fr.R: Des chiens mangeront le corps de Jézabel sur la terre de Jizreël, et personne ne l’enterrera. » Ensuite le jeune homme a ouvert la porte et il s’est sauvé.

sw.L: Naye Yezebeli mbwa watamla katika kiwanja cha Yezreeli, wala hapatakuwa na mtu wa kumzika." Akafungua mlango, akakimbia.
sw.B: Na Yezebeli, mbwa watamla katika kiwanja cha Yezreeli, wala hakuna atakayemzika." Kisha akafungua mlango, akakimbia.
sw.R: Mbwa watakula mwili wa Yezebeli katika ardhi ya Yezreeli, wala hakuna mtu atakayemzika." Kisha yule kijana akafungua mlango, akakimbia.

vi.L: Còn Giê-sa-bên, chó sẽ ăn thịt bà ta trong thửa đất ở Gít-rê-ên, và không ai chôn [bà ta]." Rồi người ấy mở cửa chạy trốn.
vi.B: Còn Giê-sa-bên thì chó sẽ ăn thịt bà ta trong thửa đất ở Gít-rê-ên, và không ai chôn bà ta." Rồi người ấy mở cửa chạy đi.
vi.R: Chó sẽ ăn xác Giê-sa-bên trên khu đất ở Gít-rê-ên, và không ai chôn bà ta." Rồi người thanh niên mở cửa chạy đi.

ko.L: 그리고 이세벨은 이스르엘 땅에서 개들이 먹을 것이고, 그를 묻어 줄 사람이 없을 것이다." 그리고 그가 문을 열고 도망쳤다.
ko.B: 이세벨은 이스르엘 땅에서 개들이 먹어 버릴 것이고, 아무도 그를 묻어 주지 않을 것이다." 그러고는 문을 열고 달아났다.
ko.R: 개들이 이스르엘 땅에서 이세벨의 시체를 먹을 것이고, 아무도 그를 묻어 주지 않을 것이다." 그러고 나서 그 젊은이는 문을 열고 달아났다.

pt.L: E Jezabel, os cães [a] comerão no terreno de Jezreel, e não haverá quem [a] sepulte." E ele abriu a porta e fugiu.
pt.B: Os cães comerão Jezabel no terreno de Jezreel, e ninguém a sepultará." Então ele abriu a porta e fugiu.
pt.R: Os cães comerão Jezabel nas terras de Jezreel, e ninguém vai sepultá-la." Então o jovem abriu a porta e fugiu.

decisions.choice: the dogs will eat Jezebel: Elijah's word against her
decisions.reason: Elijah had said, "The dogs will eat Jezebel by the rampart of Jezreel" (1 Kings 21:23). Here the place is "the plot of ground of Jezreel", the same words Jehu uses when the word comes true (verses 36-37).

decisions.choice: plot of ground: a portion of land
decisions.reason: The word means a share or portion, here the land around the town of Jezreel. It is close to the word for Naboth's plot in verses 21, 25 and 26, and Jezebel's death on this ground matches the field she had seized for Ahab.

decisions.choice: there will be none to bury her: the worst disgrace
decisions.reason: To lie unburied and be eaten by dogs was the deepest shame and a sign of a curse (1 Kings 14:11; 21:24; Jeremiah 22:19). Verses 34-35 tell how it happened.

decisions.choice: plot of ground (Literal, Balanced); the land at Jezreel (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable uses plain words for the portion of land (m2).

decisions.choice: Literal puts "이세벨은" first, as the Hebrew stresses her
decisions.reason: Korean lets the object stand first as topic, which keeps the Hebrew's emphasis.

decisions.choice: os cães comerão Jezabel (B, R); E Jezabel, os cães [a] comerão (L); o terreno (L, B), as terras (R)
alternatives: Quanto a Jezabel, os cães a comerão
decisions.reason: Elijah's word against Jezebel (m1) is echoed in the Portuguese of 1 Kings 21:23, "os cães comerão Jezabel", with "cães", the word 1 Kings 14:11 sets for the scavenging dogs; Literal keeps the Hebrew order, with Jezebel first. The portion of land (m2) is "terreno" at Literal and Balanced, the plain word for a plot of ground, used again for Naboth's plot in verses 21, 25 and 26 so that the reader can link the two; Readable says "terras".

source.text: וְיֵה֗וּא יָצָא֙ אֶל־עַבְדֵ֣י אֲדֹנָ֔יו וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ הֲשָׁל֔וֹם מַדּ֛וּעַ בָּֽא־הַמְשֻׁגָּ֥ע הַזֶּ֖ה אֵלֶ֑יךָ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אַתֶּ֛ם יְדַעְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־הָאִ֖ישׁ וְאֶת־שִׂיחֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And Jehu went out to [the] servants of his master, and one said to him, [Is it] peace? Why came this madman to you? And he said to them, You know the man and his talk.

en.L: And Jehu went out to the servants of his master, and [one] said to him, "Is it peace? Why did this madman come to you?" And he said to them, "You know the man and his talk."
en.B: When Jehu came out to his master's officers, one of them asked him, "Is all well? Why did this madman come to you?" He told them, "You know the man and the way he talks."
en.R: When Jehu came back out to the other officers of the king, one of them asked him, "Is everything all right? What did that crazy man want with you?" Jehu answered, "You know that kind of man and the kind of things he says."

es.L: Y Jehú salió a los siervos de su señor, y [uno] le dijo: «¿Hay paz? ¿Por qué vino a ti este loco?». Y él les dijo: «{{plural_you:Ustedes conocen|Vosotros conocéis}} al hombre y su palabrería».
es.B: Cuando Jehú salió adonde estaban los oficiales de su señor, uno de ellos le preguntó: «¿Va todo bien? ¿Para qué vino a verte ese loco?». Él les dijo: «Ya {{plural_you:conocen|conocéis}} al hombre y su manera de hablar».
es.R: Cuando Jehú volvió a salir adonde estaban los demás oficiales del rey, uno de ellos le preguntó: «¿Todo está bien? ¿Qué quería contigo ese loco?». Jehú respondió: «Ya {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} cómo es esa clase de hombres y las cosas que dicen».

fr.L: Et Jéhu sortit vers les serviteurs de son maître, et [l’un] lui dit : « Est-ce la paix ? Pourquoi ce fou est-il venu vers toi ? » Et il leur dit : « Vous connaissez l’homme et ses propos. »
fr.B: Quand Jéhu ressortit vers les officiers de son maître, l’un d’eux lui demanda : « Tout va bien ? Pourquoi ce fou est-il venu te trouver ? » Il leur répondit : « Vous connaissez l’homme et sa façon de parler. »
fr.R: Quand Jéhu est revenu auprès des autres officiers du roi, l’un d’eux lui a demandé : « Est-ce que tout va bien ? Qu’est-ce qu’il te voulait, ce fou ? » Jéhu a répondu : « Vous savez bien quel genre d’homme c’est, et les choses qu’il raconte. »

sw.L: Yehu akatoka kwenda kwa watumishi wa bwana wake, [mmoja] akamwambia, "Je, ni salama? Kwa nini mwenda wazimu huyu alikujia?" Akawaambia, "Mnamjua mtu huyo na maneno yake."
sw.B: Yehu alipotoka kwa maafisa wa bwana wake, mmoja wao akamwuliza, "Je, ni salama? Kwa nini mwenda wazimu huyu alikujia?" Akawaambia, "Mnamjua mtu huyo na jinsi anavyosema."
sw.R: Yehu aliporudi nje kwa maafisa wengine wa mfalme, mmoja wao akamwuliza, "Je, kila kitu ni salama? Yule mwenda wazimu alitaka nini kwako?" Yehu akajibu, "Mnamjua mtu wa namna hiyo na mambo anayosema."

vi.L: Giê-hu đi ra với các đầy tớ của chủ mình, và [một người] nói với ông: "Bình an chứ? Tại sao gã điên này đến với ông?" Ông nói với họ: "Các anh biết người ấy và lời lẽ của hắn mà."
vi.B: Khi Giê-hu đi ra với các quần thần của chủ mình, một người hỏi: "Mọi sự đều ổn chứ? Tại sao gã điên ấy đến gặp ông?" Ông đáp: "Các anh biết người ấy và kiểu nói của hắn mà."
vi.R: Khi Giê-hu trở ra gặp các sĩ quan khác của vua, một người hỏi: "Mọi việc ổn cả chứ? Gã điên ấy muốn gì ở ông?" Giê-hu trả lời: "Các anh biết hạng người ấy và những điều họ hay nói rồi đó."

ko.L: 그리고 예후가 자기 주인의 신하들에게 나오자, [그들 가운데 하나가] 그에게 말했다. "평안한 일이오? 이 미친 사람이 왜 당신에게 왔소?" 그러자 그가 그들에게 말했다. "당신들은 그 사람과 그의 말을 알지 않소."
ko.B: 예후가 자기 주인의 신하들에게 나오자, 그들 가운데 하나가 물었다. "별일 없소? 그 미친 사람이 왜 당신을 찾아왔소?" 예후가 그들에게 말했다. "당신들도 그 사람이 어떤 사람이고 어떤 말을 하는지 알지 않소."
ko.R: 예후가 왕의 다른 지휘관들에게 돌아오자, 그들 가운데 하나가 물었다. "괜찮소? 그 미친 사람이 당신에게 무슨 일로 왔소?" 예후가 대답했다. "당신들도 그런 사람이 어떤지, 무슨 말을 하는지 알지 않소."

pt.L: E Jeú saiu para junto dos servos do seu senhor, e [um] lhe disse: "Há paz? Por que este louco veio a você?" E ele lhes disse: "Vocês conhecem o homem e a conversa dele."
pt.B: Quando Jeú saiu para junto dos oficiais do seu senhor, um deles lhe perguntou: "Está tudo bem? Por que esse louco veio falar com você?" Ele lhes respondeu: "Vocês conhecem o homem e o jeito como ele fala."
pt.R: Quando Jeú voltou para junto dos outros oficiais do rei, um deles lhe perguntou: "Está tudo bem? O que aquele maluco queria com você?" Jeú respondeu: "Vocês sabem como são esses homens e as coisas que eles dizem."

decisions.choice: is it peace?: is all well?
decisions.reason: The word for peace means wholeness and well-being. As a question it asks whether all is well (4:26; 5:21). The same question is asked again and again in this chapter (verses 17-22, 31), where it asks whether Jehu comes as a friend or an enemy.

decisions.choice: this madman: a scornful name for a prophet
decisions.reason: The officers call the prophet a man who is out of his mind, perhaps because of his strange haste or the way prophets behaved (1 Samuel 10:10-11; Jeremiah 29:26; Hosea 9:7). The same root is used of Jehu's wild driving in verse 20.

decisions.choice: you know the man and his talk: Jehu brushes the question aside
decisions.reason: Jehu suggests they know what such men are like and what they say, as if the visit meant nothing, or that they had sent the man themselves. The officers do not accept the answer (verse 12).

decisions.choice: his master's officers (Balanced); the other officers of the king (Readable)
decisions.reason: The king's "servants" are his officers, as in Samuel and Kings: Literal keeps "servants", and Balanced and Readable say "officers" since these are army commanders.

decisions.choice: Is all well? (Balanced); Is everything all right? (Readable)
decisions.reason: Here the question is the officers' concern about the visit (m1). In verses 17-31 it is asked of someone approaching, and is worded "Is it peace?" (Literal, Balanced) and "Do you come in peace?" (Readable) every time.

decisions.choice: ¿Hay paz? (Literal); ¿Va todo bien? (Balanced); ¿Todo está bien? (Readable)
decisions.reason: Here the question is the officers' concern about the visit (m1); from verse 17 it is asked of someone approaching and takes one wording through the chapter.

decisions.choice: "Je, ni salama?" here; "Je, ni amani?" in verses 17-22 and 31
decisions.reason: The officers ask about Jehu's welfare, so Swahili uses "salama", as at 4:26; where the question is put to someone approaching and its answer is about war or peace, Swahili keeps "amani" so the repeated word can be heard.

decisions.choice: Jehu calls his fellow officers "các anh"; they call him "ông"
decisions.reason: The commanders are equals, his "brothers" (verse 2), until they proclaim him king.

decisions.choice: Jehu and his fellow officers speak to each other in 하오체
decisions.reason: Officers of the same rank speak as equals; 하오체 suits grown men of standing.

decisions.choice: Há paz? (L), Está tudo bem? (B, R); este louco (L, B), aquele maluco (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the question that runs through the chapter, "Há paz?" (verse 17), and Balanced and Readable ask whether all is well, as the English does here (m1). The scornful name for the prophet (m2) is "louco", the word that comes back in "como um louco" for Jehu's driving (verse 20), so that the reader hears the same root; Readable says the everyday "maluco". The officers speak to Jehu as equals, with "você".

source.text: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ שֶׁ֔קֶר הַגֶּד־נָ֖א לָ֑נוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר כָּזֹ֤את וְכָזֹאת֙ אָמַ֤ר אֵלַי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה מְשַׁחְתִּ֥יךָֽ לְמֶ֖לֶךְ אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And they said, Falsehood! Tell please to us. And he said, Like this and like this he said to me, saying, Thus says Yahweh, I have anointed you to king over Israel.

en.L: And they said, "A lie! Tell us, please." And he said, "Like this and like this he spoke to me, saying, 'Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: I anoint you king over Israel.'"
en.B: But they said, "That is not true! Tell us." So he said, "This is what he told me: '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: I anoint you king over Israel.'"
en.R: "That is not the truth!" they said. "Tell us what he said." So Jehu told them, "He said to me, 'This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: I am making you king over Israel.'"

es.L: Y ellos dijeron: «¡Mentira! Cuéntanos, te rogamos». Y él dijo: «Así y así me habló, diciendo: “Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Te unjo como rey sobre Israel”».
es.B: Pero ellos dijeron: «¡Eso no es cierto! Cuéntanos». Entonces él dijo: «Esto es lo que me dijo: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: Te unjo como rey de Israel”».
es.R: «¡No es verdad!», dijeron ellos. «Cuéntanos lo que te dijo». Entonces Jehú les contó: «Me dijo: “Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Te hago rey de Israel”».

fr.L: Et ils dirent : « Mensonge ! Raconte-nous donc. » Et il dit : « Il m’a parlé ainsi et ainsi, en disant : “Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Je t’oins roi sur Israël.” »
fr.B: Mais ils dirent : « Ce n’est pas vrai ! Dis-nous tout. » Il dit alors : « Voici ce qu’il m’a dit : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Je t’oins roi d’Israël.” »
fr.R: « Ce n’est pas la vérité ! ont-ils dit. Dis-nous ce qu’il t’a dit. » Alors Jéhu leur a raconté : « Il m’a dit : “Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Je fais de toi le roi d’Israël.” »

sw.L: Wakasema, "Uongo! Tafadhali tuambie." Akasema, "Hivi na hivi ndivyo alivyoniambia, akisema, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Nimekupaka mafuta uwe mfalme juu ya Israeli.'"
sw.B: Lakini wakasema, "Si kweli! Tuambie." Basi akasema, "Hivi ndivyo alivyoniambia: 'Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Nakupaka mafuta uwe mfalme juu ya Israeli.'"
sw.R: Wakasema, "Hiyo si kweli! Tuambie alichosema." Basi Yehu akawaambia, "Aliniambia, 'Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Ninakufanya mfalme juu ya Israeli.'"

vi.L: Họ nói: "Nói dối! Xin hãy cho chúng tôi biết." Ông nói: "Hắn đã nói với tôi thế này thế này: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Ta xức dầu cho ngươi làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.'"
vi.B: Nhưng họ nói: "Không phải thế! Hãy nói cho chúng tôi biết đi." Vậy ông nói: "Hắn bảo tôi thế này: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Ta xức dầu cho ngươi làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.'"
vi.R: Họ nói: "Ông không nói thật! Hãy cho chúng tôi biết hắn đã nói gì." Vậy Giê-hu kể: "Hắn bảo tôi: 'Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Ta lập ngươi làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.'"

ko.L: 그러자 그들이 말했다. "거짓말이오! 우리에게 말해 주시오." 그러자 그가 말했다. "그가 내게 이러이러하게 말했소. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하십니다. 내가 너에게 기름을 부어 이스라엘의 왕으로 세운다.'"
ko.B: 그러나 그들이 말했다. "그게 아니지 않소! 우리에게 말해 주시오." 그래서 예후가 말했다. "그가 내게 이렇게 말했소. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하십니다. 내가 너에게 기름을 부어 이스라엘의 왕으로 세운다.'"
ko.R: 그들이 말했다. "그건 사실이 아니오! 그가 무슨 말을 했는지 말해 주시오." 그러자 예후가 말했다. "그가 내게 이렇게 말했소. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀은 이것입니다. 내가 너를 이스라엘의 왕으로 세운다.'"

pt.L: E eles disseram: "Mentira! Conte-nos, por favor." E ele disse: "Assim e assim ele me falou, dizendo: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Eu te unjo rei sobre Israel.'"
pt.B: Mas eles disseram: "Não é verdade! Conte para nós." Então ele disse: "Foi isto que ele me disse: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Eu te unjo rei sobre Israel.'"
pt.R: "Isso não é verdade!", disseram eles. "Conte o que ele disse." Então Jeú contou: "Ele me disse: 'É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: Eu estou fazendo de ti o rei de Israel.'"

decisions.choice: a lie: you are not telling us the truth
decisions.reason: The single word is an exclamation: the officers will not accept Jehu's evasive answer and press him to tell them.

decisions.choice: like this and like this: this is what he said
decisions.reason: The repeated phrase sums up the man's speech without repeating it all (compare 5:4); Jehu then gives its heart, the words of Yahweh.

decisions.choice: I anoint you: as in verse 3
decisions.reason: Jehu repeats the words Elisha gave the young man.

decisions.choice: This is what he told me (Balanced); He said to me (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the summary phrase (m2); Literal keeps it.

source.text: וַֽיְמַהֲר֗וּ וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ בִּגְד֔וֹ וַיָּשִׂ֥ימוּ תַחְתָּ֖יו אֶל־גֶּ֣רֶם הַֽמַּעֲל֑וֹת וַֽיִּתְקְעוּ֙ בַּשּׁוֹפָ֔ר וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ מָלַ֥ךְ יֵהֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: And they hurried and took each his garment and put [it] under him on [the] bare [part of] the steps, and they blew on the trumpet and said, Is king Jehu!

en.L: And they hurried and took each man his garment and put [it] under him on the bare steps, and they blew the trumpet and said, "Jehu is king!"
en.B: At once each man took off his cloak and spread it under Jehu on the bare steps. They blew the ram's horn and shouted, "Jehu is king!"
en.R: Right away each of them took off his coat and spread it on the steps for Jehu to stand on. Then they blew a trumpet and shouted, "Jehu is king!"

es.L: Y se apresuraron y tomó cada uno su manto y [lo] puso debajo de él sobre los peldaños mismos, y tocaron la trompeta y dijeron: «¡Jehú es rey!».
es.B: Enseguida cada uno se quitó el manto y lo tendió bajo Jehú sobre los peldaños desnudos. Tocaron el cuerno de carnero y gritaron: «¡Jehú es rey!».
es.R: Enseguida cada uno se quitó el manto y lo tendió sobre los peldaños para que Jehú se parara encima. Luego tocaron la trompeta y gritaron: «¡Jehú es rey!».

fr.L: Et ils se hâtèrent et prirent chacun son vêtement et [le] mirent sous lui sur les marches mêmes ; et ils sonnèrent de la trompette et dirent : « Jéhu est roi ! »
fr.B: Aussitôt, chacun prit son manteau et l’étendit sous Jéhu, sur les marches nues. Ils sonnèrent du cor et crièrent : « Jéhu est roi ! »
fr.R: Tout de suite, chacun d’eux a enlevé son manteau et l’a étendu sur les marches pour que Jéhu s’y tienne. Puis ils ont sonné de la trompette et ils ont crié : « Jéhu est roi ! »

sw.L: Wakafanya haraka, wakachukua kila mtu vazi lake, wakaliweka chini yake juu ya ngazi zenyewe, wakapiga tarumbeta, wakasema, "Yehu ni mfalme!"
sw.B: Mara kila mtu akavua vazi lake, akalitandika chini ya Yehu juu ya ngazi tupu. Wakapiga pembe ya kondoo dume, wakapaza sauti, "Yehu ni mfalme!"
sw.R: Mara kila mmoja wao akavua koti lake, akalitandika juu ya ngazi ili Yehu asimame juu yake. Kisha wakapiga tarumbeta, wakapaza sauti, "Yehu ni mfalme!"

vi.L: Họ vội vàng, mỗi người lấy áo mình trải dưới chân ông trên bậc thềm trống, rồi họ thổi kèn và nói: "Giê-hu là vua!"
vi.B: Lập tức mỗi người cởi áo choàng mình trải dưới chân Giê-hu trên các bậc thềm trống. Họ thổi tù và và hô lên: "Giê-hu là vua!"
vi.R: Ngay lập tức, mỗi người cởi áo khoác của mình trải trên bậc thềm cho Giê-hu đứng lên. Rồi họ thổi kèn và hô lớn: "Giê-hu là vua!"

ko.L: 그러자 그들이 급히 각자 자기 겉옷을 가져다가 계단 바로 위에 그의 발밑에 깔고, 나팔을 불며 말했다. "예후가 왕이다!"
ko.B: 그러자 그들은 곧바로 저마다 겉옷을 벗어 계단 위 예후의 발밑에 깔았다. 그리고 숫양 뿔 나팔을 불며 외쳤다. "예후가 왕이다!"
ko.R: 그러자 그들은 곧바로 저마다 겉옷을 벗어 예후가 밟고 설 수 있도록 계단 위에 깔았다. 그리고 나팔을 불며 외쳤다. "예후가 왕이다!"

pt.L: E eles se apressaram, e cada homem tomou a sua roupa e [a] pôs debaixo dele, sobre os degraus nus; e tocaram o chifre de carneiro e disseram: "Jeú é rei!"
pt.B: Imediatamente cada um tirou o manto e o estendeu debaixo de Jeú, sobre os degraus nus. Tocaram o chifre de carneiro e gritaram: "Jeú é rei!"
pt.R: Na mesma hora, cada um deles tirou a capa e a estendeu nos degraus para Jeú pisar. Depois tocaram a trombeta e gritaram: "Jeú é rei!"

decisions.choice: each man spread his garment under him: honoring him as king
decisions.reason: Spreading cloaks under someone was a sign of homage, laying down the way for a king (compare Matthew 21:8). The officers declare their loyalty to Jehu at once.

decisions.choice: the bare steps: the steps themselves, uncertain
decisions.reason: The first word usually means "bone" and may here mean the bare stone of the steps, or the top of the stairs, where Jehu could be seen as on a throne. The exact sense is not known.

decisions.choice: they blew the trumpet and said, Jehu is king: the public proclamation of a new king
decisions.reason: The ram's horn and the shout announced a new king, as for Absalom (2 Samuel 15:10) and Solomon (1 Kings 1:34, 39).

decisions.choice: trumpet (Literal, Readable); ram's horn (Balanced)
decisions.reason: As in Judges 6:34 and 1 Kings 1:34: Literal and Readable use the familiar word, and Balanced names the instrument.

decisions.choice: for Jehu to stand on
decisions.reason: Readable says why the cloaks were spread under him.

decisions.choice: el cuerno de carnero
decisions.reason: As the English Balanced, Balanced names the instrument; Literal and Readable use the familiar "trompeta".

decisions.choice: "le cor" (B); "la trompette" (L, R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Balanced names the ram’s horn (*shofar*), "le cor" as in the French Samuel drafts; Literal and Readable keep the general word.

decisions.choice: "kèn" (L, R); "tù và" (B)
decisions.reason: The shofar, a ram's horn; the 2 Samuel drafts use "kèn" where the English says trumpet and "tù và" where it says ram's horn.

decisions.choice: "숫양 뿔 나팔" at Balanced for the *shofar*; "나팔" at Literal and Readable
decisions.reason: As the English Balanced "ram's horn"; "숫양 뿔 나팔" says what the instrument was in plain words.

decisions.choice: Jeú é rei! (every level); o chifre de carneiro (L, B), a trombeta (R)
decisions.reason: The proclamation (m3) is the short cry Portuguese uses to announce a new king, "Jeú é rei!", at every level, as the English. The instrument keeps the words of 1 Kings 1:34 in Portuguese: "chifre de carneiro" at Literal and Balanced and "trombeta" at Readable, where the English Readable says "trumpet".

source.text: וַיִּתְקַשֵּׁ֗ר יֵה֛וּא בֶּן־יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן־נִמְשִׁ֖י אֶל־יוֹרָ֑ם וְיוֹרָם֩ הָיָ֨ה שֹׁמֵ֜ר בְּרָמֹ֣ת גִּלְעָ֗ד ה֚וּא וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִפְּנֵ֥י חֲזָאֵ֖ל מֶֽלֶךְ־אֲרָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And conspired Jehu son of Jehoshaphat son of Nimshi against Joram; and Joram had been keeping [watch] at Ramoth-gilead, he and all Israel, from before Hazael king of Aram.

en.L: So Jehu son of Jehoshaphat son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. Now Joram had been keeping guard at Ramoth-gilead, he and all Israel, against Hazael king of Aram,
en.B: So Jehu son of Jehoshaphat son of Nimshi plotted against Joram. Joram and all Israel had been holding Ramoth-gilead against Hazael king of Aram,
en.R: So Jehu son of Jehoshaphat and grandson of Nimshi made plans to overthrow King Joram. Joram and the whole army of Israel had been guarding the town of Ramoth-gilead against Hazael, the king of Aram.

es.L: Así conspiró Jehú hijo de Josafat hijo de Nimsi contra Joram. Y Joram había estado guardando Ramot de Galaad, él y todo Israel, frente a Hazael, rey de Aram,
es.B: Así Jehú hijo de Josafat hijo de Nimsi conspiró contra Joram. Joram y todo Israel habían estado defendiendo Ramot de Galaad contra Hazael, rey de Aram,
es.R: Así que Jehú, hijo de Josafat y nieto de Nimsi, hizo planes para derrocar al rey Joram. Joram y todo el ejército de Israel habían estado defendiendo la ciudad de Ramot de Galaad contra Hazael, el rey de Aram.

fr.L: Et Jéhu fils de Josaphat fils de Nimshi conspira contre Joram. Or Joram montait la garde à Ramoth de Galaad, lui et tout Israël, contre Hazaël, roi d’Aram,
fr.B: Jéhu, fils de Josaphat, fils de Nimshi, complota donc contre Joram. Joram et tout Israël avaient tenu Ramoth de Galaad face à Hazaël, roi d’Aram,
fr.R: Jéhu, fils de Josaphat et petit-fils de Nimshi, a donc préparé un complot pour renverser le roi Joram. Joram et toute l’armée d’Israël avaient défendu la ville de Ramoth de Galaad contre Hazaël, le roi d’Aram.

sw.L: Hivyo Yehu mwana wa Yehoshafati mwana wa Nimshi akafanya fitina juu ya Yoramu. Basi Yoramu alikuwa akilinda huko Ramoth-gileadi, yeye na Israeli wote, dhidi ya Hazaeli mfalme wa Aramu,
sw.B: Hivyo Yehu mwana wa Yehoshafati mwana wa Nimshi alifanya njama dhidi ya Yoramu. Yoramu na Israeli wote walikuwa wakiulinda Ramoth-gileadi dhidi ya Hazaeli mfalme wa Aramu,
sw.R: Hivyo Yehu mwana wa Yehoshafati, mjukuu wa Nimshi, alipanga kumpindua mfalme Yoramu. Yoramu na jeshi lote la Israeli walikuwa wakiulinda mji wa Ramoth-gileadi dhidi ya Hazaeli mfalme wa Aramu.

vi.L: Vậy Giê-hu con trai Giô-sa-phát, con trai Nim-si, mưu phản Giô-ram. Lúc ấy Giô-ram đang canh giữ Ra-mốt ở Ga-la-át, vua và toàn thể Y-sơ-ra-ên, chống lại Ha-xa-ên vua A-ram,
vi.B: Vậy Giê-hu con trai Giô-sa-phát, cháu Nim-si, âm mưu chống lại Giô-ram. Giô-ram và toàn quân Y-sơ-ra-ên đã giữ Ra-mốt ở Ga-la-át chống lại Ha-xa-ên vua A-ram,
vi.R: Vậy Giê-hu con trai Giô-sa-phát, cháu Nim-si, lập mưu lật đổ vua Giô-ram. Giô-ram và toàn quân Y-sơ-ra-ên đã canh giữ thành Ra-mốt ở Ga-la-át để chống lại Ha-xa-ên vua A-ram.

ko.L: 그리하여 님시의 아들 여호사밧의 아들 예후가 요람에게 반역을 꾀했다. 그때 요람은 그와 온 이스라엘이 아람 왕 하사엘을 막으려고 길르앗 라못을 지키고 있었는데,
ko.B: 그리하여 님시의 손자이며 여호사밧의 아들인 예후가 요람에게 반역을 꾀했다. 그때 요람은 온 이스라엘과 함께 아람 왕 하사엘을 막으려고 길르앗 라못을 지키고 있었는데,
ko.R: 그리하여 님시의 손자이며 여호사밧의 아들인 예후가 요람 왕을 몰아낼 계획을 세웠다. 요람은 이스라엘의 온 군대와 함께 길르앗 라못 성을 지키며 아람 왕 하사엘과 맞서고 있었다.

pt.L: E Jeú, filho de Josafá, filho de Ninsi, conspirou contra Jorão. E Jorão estava guardando Ramote-Gileade, ele e todo o Israel, contra Hazael, rei de Arã,
pt.B: Assim Jeú, filho de Josafá, filho de Ninsi, conspirou contra Jorão. Jorão e todo o Israel tinham defendido Ramote-Gileade contra Hazael, rei dos arameus,
pt.R: Assim Jeú, filho de Josafá e neto de Ninsi, fez planos para derrubar o rei Jorão. Jorão e todo o exército de Israel vinham defendendo a cidade de Ramote-Gileade contra Hazael, o rei dos arameus.

decisions.choice: conspired: formed a plot against the king
decisions.reason: The verb is used of plots to kill a king and take the throne (1 Kings 15:27; 16:9). Jehu acts on the prophet's word, but by the means of a palace revolt.

decisions.choice: Joram had been keeping guard: background to the story
decisions.reason: Verses 14b-15a go back to explain the situation already told in 8:28-29: Joram had held Ramoth-gilead against Aram, been wounded and gone to Jezreel to recover.

decisions.choice: Joram: the son of Ahab, king of Israel
decisions.reason: Joram (also spelled Jehoram in verses 15, 17 and elsewhere) was Ahab's son and king of Israel (3:1). Ahaziah king of Judah, his nephew, had joined him (8:28-29).

decisions.choice: a full stop at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: The background sentence runs on into verse 15, so Literal and Balanced end the verse with a comma; Readable makes it a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: made plans to overthrow King Joram
decisions.reason: Readable explains what "conspired" meant here.

decisions.choice: Literal and Balanced leave verse 14 open ("지키고 있었는데,") into verse 15, as the English does; Readable closes it
decisions.reason: The Korean connective carries the sentence over the verse break without moving words between verses.

decisions.choice: conspirou (L, B); fez planos para derrubar (R); Jorão; rei de Arã (L), rei dos arameus (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb for a plot against a king (m1) is "conspirar" at Literal and Balanced, the word 1 Kings 16:9 uses for Zimri in Portuguese, which Jezebel's taunt recalls in verse 31; Readable says what the plot was, as the English does. "Jorão" as the shared list for Kings has it; Hazael's land and people as 1 Kings 15:18 sets them for the book.

source.text: וַיָּשָׁב֩ יְהוֹרָ֨ם הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ לְהִתְרַפֵּ֣א בִיְזְרְעֶ֗אל מִן־הַמַּכִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַכֻּ֣הוּ אֲרַמִּ֔ים בְּהִלָּ֣חֲמ֔וֹ אֶת־חֲזָאֵ֖ל מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֑ם וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יֵהוּא֙ אִם־יֵ֣שׁ נַפְשְׁכֶ֔ם אַל־יֵצֵ֤א פָלִיט֙ מִן־הָעִ֔יר לָלֶ֖כֶת לְהַגִּ֥יד בְּיִזְרְעֶֽאל׃

records.literal_gloss: and returned Joram the king to get himself healed in Jezreel from the wounds which struck him [the] Arameans in his fighting with Hazael king of Aram. And said Jehu, If is your mind, let not go out an escapee from the city to go to tell in Jezreel.

en.L: but King Jehoram had returned to be healed in Jezreel from the wounds that the Arameans had struck him with when he fought with Hazael king of Aram. And Jehu said, "If this is your will, let no survivor go out from the city to go and tell [it] in Jezreel."
en.B: but King Jehoram had gone back to Jezreel to recover from the wounds the Arameans had given him when he fought Hazael king of Aram. Jehu said, "If you are with me, do not let anyone slip out of the city to go and tell the news in Jezreel."
en.R: But King Jehoram had gone back to the town of Jezreel to get better from the wounds the Arameans gave him in the battle against Hazael. Jehu said to the officers, "If you agree with me, do not let anyone leave the city to go and warn the people in Jezreel."

es.L: pero el rey Jehoram había vuelto para curarse en Jezreel de las heridas que los arameos le habían hecho cuando peleó contra Hazael, rey de Aram. Y Jehú dijo: «Si es {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} voluntad, que no salga de la ciudad ningún fugitivo para ir a avisar en Jezreel».
es.B: pero el rey Jehoram había vuelto a Jezreel para recuperarse de las heridas que los arameos le habían causado cuando peleó contra Hazael, rey de Aram. Jehú dijo: «Si {{plural_you:están|estáis}} conmigo, no {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que nadie se escape de la ciudad para ir a dar la noticia en Jezreel».
es.R: Pero el rey Jehoram había vuelto a la ciudad de Jezreel para curarse de las heridas que los arameos le hicieron en la batalla contra Hazael. Jehú les dijo a los oficiales: «Si {{plural_you:están|estáis}} de acuerdo conmigo, no {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que nadie salga de la ciudad para ir a avisar a la gente de Jezreel».
