vi.R: Các quần thần chở xác vua bằng xe về Giê-ru-sa-lem. Họ chôn vua trong mộ của vua cùng với tổ tiên tại thành Đa-vít.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 신하들이 그를 병거에 싣고 예루살렘으로 가서, 다윗 성에 있는 그의 무덤에 그의 조상들과 함께 묻었다.
ko.B: 그의 신하들이 그를 병거에 싣고 예루살렘으로 가서, 다윗 성에 있는 그의 무덤에 조상들과 함께 묻었다.
ko.R: 그의 신하들이 그의 시체를 병거에 싣고 예루살렘으로 갔다. 그들은 다윗 성에 있는 그의 무덤에 그를 조상들과 함께 묻었다.

pt.L: E os seus servos o levaram num carro a Jerusalém e o sepultaram na sua sepultura com os seus pais na Cidade de Davi.
pt.B: Os seus oficiais o levaram num carro para Jerusalém e o sepultaram com os seus antepassados no seu túmulo, na Cidade de Davi.
pt.R: Os seus oficiais levaram o corpo dele num carro até Jerusalém. Eles o sepultaram no túmulo dele, com os seus antepassados, na Cidade de Davi.

decisions.choice: carried him in a chariot: made him ride
decisions.reason: The verb means "made him ride"; the body was taken home in a chariot.

decisions.choice: buried with his fathers in the City of David: a royal burial
decisions.reason: Unlike Joram and Jezebel, Ahaziah received a king's burial in the family tomb in Jerusalem (8:24).

decisions.choice: servants (Literal); officials (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The king's servants are his court officials, as settled for Samuel and Kings.

decisions.choice: com os seus pais (L); com os seus antepassados (B, R); na Cidade de Davi
decisions.reason: The royal burial (m2) keeps the words of the death formula set for the book at 1 Kings 2:10: "os seus pais" at Literal and "os seus antepassados" at Balanced and Readable, and "a Cidade de Davi" with capitals as a name.

source.text: וּבִשְׁנַת֙ אַחַ֣ת עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לְיוֹרָ֖ם בֶּן־אַחְאָ֑ב מָלַ֥ךְ אֲחַזְיָ֖ה עַל־יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And in year one [and] ten year of Joram son of Ahab had become king Ahaziah over Judah.

en.L: And in the eleventh year of Joram son of Ahab, Ahaziah had become king over Judah.
en.B: Ahaziah had become king over Judah in the eleventh year of Joram son of Ahab.
en.R: Ahaziah had become king of Judah in the eleventh year that Joram son of Ahab was king of Israel.

es.L: Y en el año once de Joram hijo de Acab, Ocozías había comenzado a reinar sobre Judá.
es.B: Ocozías había comenzado a reinar sobre Judá en el año once de Joram hijo de Acab.
es.R: Ocozías había llegado a ser rey de Judá en el año once del reinado de Joram hijo de Acab en Israel.

fr.L: Et en la onzième année de Joram fils d’Achab, Achazia était devenu roi sur Juda.
fr.B: Achazia était devenu roi de Juda la onzième année du règne de Joram, fils d’Achab.
fr.R: Achazia était devenu roi de Juda la onzième année où Joram, fils d’Achab, était roi d’Israël.

sw.L: Na katika mwaka wa kumi na moja wa Yoramu mwana wa Ahabu, Ahazia alikuwa ameanza kutawala juu ya Yuda.
sw.B: Ahazia alikuwa ameanza kutawala juu ya Yuda katika mwaka wa kumi na moja wa Yoramu mwana wa Ahabu.
sw.R: Ahazia alikuwa amekuwa mfalme wa Yuda katika mwaka wa kumi na moja wa utawala wa Yoramu mwana wa Ahabu juu ya Israeli.

vi.L: A-cha-xia đã lên làm vua Giu-đa vào năm thứ mười một đời Giô-ram con trai A-háp.
vi.B: A-cha-xia đã lên làm vua Giu-đa vào năm thứ mười một đời Giô-ram con trai A-háp.
vi.R: A-cha-xia đã lên làm vua Giu-đa vào năm thứ mười một đời Giô-ram con trai A-háp làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 아합의 아들 요람 제11년에 아하시야가 유다의 왕이 되었었다.
ko.B: 아하시야는 아합의 아들 요람이 다스린 지 11년째 되는 해에 유다의 왕이 되었었다.
ko.R: 아하시야는 아합의 아들 요람이 이스라엘을 다스린 지 11년째 되는 해에 유다의 왕이 되었었다.

pt.L: E no décimo primeiro ano de Jorão, filho de Acabe, Acazias tinha começado a reinar sobre Judá.
pt.B: Acazias tinha começado a reinar sobre Judá no décimo primeiro ano de Jorão, filho de Acabe.
pt.R: Acazias tinha se tornado rei de Judá no décimo primeiro ano em que Jorão, filho de Acabe, era rei de Israel.

decisions.choice: had become king: a note looking back
decisions.reason: The narrator adds a note on when Ahaziah's reign began, closing the account of his life.

decisions.choice: the eleventh year: one year apart from 8:25
decisions.reason: 8:25 dates Ahaziah's accession to Joram's twelfth year. The difference probably comes from two ways of counting a king's years, with or without the part year in which he came to the throne.

decisions.choice: that Joram son of Ahab was king of Israel
decisions.reason: Readable says that the years are counted from Joram's reign in Israel.

decisions.choice: no décimo primeiro ano de X (L, B), no décimo primeiro ano em que X era rei de Israel (R); tinha começado a reinar (L, B), tinha se tornado rei (R)
decisions.reason: The note on the start of the reign (m1) keeps the synchronism of 1 Kings 15:1 as set for the book, with the year as an ordinal; the pluperfect says that it looks back, as the English "had become king" does.

source.text: וַיָּב֥וֹא יֵה֖וּא יִזְרְעֶ֑אלָה וְאִיזֶ֣בֶל שָׁמְעָ֗ה וַתָּ֨שֶׂם בַּפּ֤וּךְ עֵינֶ֨יהָ֙ וַתֵּ֣יטֶב אֶת־רֹאשָׁ֔הּ וַתַּשְׁקֵ֖ף בְּעַ֥ד הַחַלּֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And came Jehu [to] Jezreel, and Jezebel heard, and she put in eye-paint her eyes and made good her head and looked down through the window.

en.L: And Jehu came to Jezreel, and Jezebel heard [of it], and she put her eyes in paint and adorned her head, and looked down through the window.
en.B: Then Jehu came to Jezreel. When Jezebel heard of it, she painted her eyes, arranged her hair and looked down from the window.
en.R: Then Jehu arrived in Jezreel. When Jezebel heard he was coming, she put on eye makeup and fixed her hair. Then she looked down from an upstairs window.

es.L: Y llegó Jehú a Jezreel, y Jezabel [lo] oyó, y se pintó los ojos con afeite y se adornó la cabeza, y se asomó por la ventana.
es.B: Luego Jehú llegó a Jezreel. Cuando Jezabel se enteró, se pintó los ojos, se arregló el cabello y se asomó a la ventana.
es.R: Después Jehú llegó a Jezreel. Cuando Jezabel supo que venía, se maquilló los ojos y se peinó. Luego se asomó a una ventana del piso de arriba.

fr.L: Et Jéhu arriva à Jizreël, et Jézabel l’apprit ; et elle mit du fard à ses yeux, orna sa tête et regarda par la fenêtre.
fr.B: Puis Jéhu arriva à Jizreël. Quand Jézabel l’apprit, elle se farda les yeux, se coiffa et regarda par la fenêtre.
fr.R: Ensuite Jéhu est arrivé à Jizreël. Quand Jézabel a appris qu’il venait, elle s’est maquillé les yeux et elle s’est coiffée. Puis elle a regardé en bas par une fenêtre de l’étage.

sw.L: Yehu akaja Yezreeli, naye Yezebeli akasikia, akapaka macho yake wanja, akapamba kichwa chake, akachungulia dirishani.
sw.B: Kisha Yehu akaja Yezreeli. Yezebeli aliposikia habari hiyo, alipaka macho yake wanja, akatengeneza nywele zake, akachungulia dirishani.
sw.R: Kisha Yehu akafika Yezreeli. Yezebeli aliposikia kwamba anakuja, alijipaka wanja machoni na kutengeneza nywele zake. Kisha akachungulia kutoka dirisha la ghorofani.

vi.L: Giê-hu đến Gít-rê-ên. Giê-sa-bên nghe [tin ấy], bèn kẻ mắt, trang điểm đầu tóc, và nhìn xuống qua cửa sổ.
vi.B: Rồi Giê-hu đến Gít-rê-ên. Khi Giê-sa-bên nghe tin, bà kẻ mắt, chải chuốt đầu tóc, rồi nhìn xuống qua cửa sổ.
vi.R: Rồi Giê-hu đến Gít-rê-ên. Khi nghe tin Giê-hu đến, Giê-sa-bên trang điểm mắt và sửa sang đầu tóc. Rồi bà nhìn xuống từ một cửa sổ trên lầu.

ko.L: 그리고 예후가 이스르엘에 왔다. 그리고 이세벨이 [그 소식을] 듣고, 자기 눈에 화장을 하고 머리를 꾸미고 창으로 내려다보았다.
ko.B: 예후가 이스르엘에 이르렀다. 이세벨은 그 소식을 듣고 눈에 화장을 하고 머리를 단장한 다음, 창문으로 내려다보았다.
ko.R: 예후가 이스르엘에 도착했다. 이세벨은 예후가 온다는 말을 듣고 눈 화장을 하고 머리를 매만졌다. 그리고 위층 창문에서 아래를 내려다보았다.

pt.L: E Jeú chegou a Jezreel, e Jezabel ouviu [isso], e pintou os olhos com tinta, enfeitou a cabeça e olhou para baixo pela janela.
pt.B: Então Jeú chegou a Jezreel. Quando Jezabel soube disso, pintou os olhos, arrumou o cabelo e ficou olhando lá de cima pela janela.
pt.R: Então Jeú chegou a Jezreel. Quando Jezabel soube que ele estava vindo, pintou os olhos e arrumou o cabelo. Depois foi olhar por uma janela do andar de cima.

decisions.choice: she painted her eyes: she put on dark eye paint
decisions.reason: Women outlined their eyes with a dark powder made from minerals (Jeremiah 4:30; Ezekiel 23:40).

decisions.choice: adorned her head and looked down through the window: she met Jehu as a queen
decisions.reason: Jezebel prepared herself with royal dignity, perhaps putting on her headdress, and faced Jehu from the palace window. The text does not say she meant to seduce him; her words in verse 31 are scorn, not welcome. She meets death as a queen.

decisions.choice: looked down: looked out from above
decisions.reason: The verb is used of looking down from a height or a window (Judges 5:28; 2 Samuel 6:16). The window was in an upper room of the palace.

decisions.choice: painted her eyes, arranged her hair (Balanced); put on eye makeup and fixed her hair (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Made good her head" means she did her hair or headdress; Balanced and Readable say it in plain words.

decisions.choice: pintou os olhos (every level; com tinta at L); enfeitou a cabeça (L), arrumou o cabelo (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Pintar os olhos" is the plain Portuguese for putting on eye paint (m1), so every level says it, Readable included, where the English says "eye makeup"; Literal adds "com tinta" for the Hebrew noun. Literal keeps "enfeitou a cabeça" (m2), and Balanced and Readable say that she did her hair, as the English does.

source.text: וְיֵה֖וּא בָּ֣א בַשָּׁ֑עַר וַתֹּ֣אמֶר הֲשָׁל֔וֹם זִמְרִ֖י הֹרֵ֥ג אֲדֹנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And Jehu came in the gate, and she said, [Is it] peace, Zimri, murderer of his master?

en.L: And Jehu came in at the gate, and she said, "Is it peace, Zimri, murderer of his master?"
en.B: As Jehu came in through the gate, she said, "Is it peace, you Zimri, murderer of your master?"
en.R: As Jehu came through the city gate, she called out, "Do you come in peace, you Zimri? You murdered your master!"

es.L: Y Jehú entró por la puerta, y ella dijo: «¿Hay paz, Zimri, asesino de su señor?».
es.B: Cuando Jehú entraba por la puerta, ella le dijo: «¿Hay paz, Zimri, asesino de tu señor?».
es.R: Cuando Jehú entraba por la puerta de la ciudad, ella le gritó: «¿Vienes en paz, Zimri? ¡Asesinaste a tu señor!».

fr.L: Et Jéhu entrait par la porte, et elle dit : « Est-ce la paix, Zimri, assassin de son maître ? »
fr.B: Comme Jéhu franchissait la porte, elle lui dit : « Est-ce la paix, Zimri, assassin de ton maître ? »
fr.R: Pendant que Jéhu passait la porte de la ville, elle lui a crié : « Viens-tu en paix, Zimri ? Tu as assassiné ton maître ! »

sw.L: Yehu alipoingia langoni, akasema, "Je, ni amani, Zimri, mwuaji wa bwana wake?"
sw.B: Yehu alipokuwa akiingia langoni, Yezebeli akasema, "Je, ni amani, wewe Zimri, mwuaji wa bwana wako?"
sw.R: Yehu alipokuwa akiingia kupitia lango la mji, Yezebeli akapaza sauti, "Je, unakuja kwa amani, wewe Zimri? Umemwua bwana wako!"

vi.L: Khi Giê-hu vào cổng thành, bà nói: "Bình an chứ, hỡi Xim-ri, kẻ giết chủ mình?"
vi.B: Khi Giê-hu đi qua cổng thành, bà nói: "Bình an chứ, hỡi tên Xim-ri, kẻ giết chủ mình?"
vi.R: Khi Giê-hu đi qua cổng thành, bà gọi lớn: "Ngươi đến với thiện ý chứ, hỡi tên Xim-ri? Ngươi đã giết chủ ngươi!"

ko.L: 그리고 예후가 성문으로 들어오자 그가 말했다. "자기 주인을 죽인 시므리야, 평안이냐?"
ko.B: 예후가 성문으로 들어오자 이세벨이 말했다. "네 주인을 죽인 이 시므리야, 평안이냐?"
ko.R: 예후가 성문으로 들어오자 이세벨이 소리쳤다. "이 시므리 같은 놈아, 좋은 뜻으로 오는 것이냐? 너는 네 주인을 죽였다!"

pt.L: E Jeú entrou pela porta, e ela disse: "Há paz, Zinri, assassino do seu senhor?"
pt.B: Quando Jeú entrou pela porta da cidade, ela disse: "Há paz, Zinri, assassino do seu senhor?"
pt.R: Quando Jeú passou pela porta da cidade, ela gritou: "Você vem em paz, Zinri? Você matou o seu senhor!"

decisions.choice: Zimri, murderer of his master: a taunt
decisions.reason: Zimri, a chariot commander, killed his king Elah and took the throne, but he reigned only seven days before Omri, Ahab's father, besieged him and he died in the burning palace (1 Kings 16:9-18). Jezebel calls Jehu "Zimri" to warn him that a traitor's reign does not last.

decisions.choice: is it peace?: mockery
decisions.reason: Jezebel asks the question the messengers and the king had asked (verses 17-22), now with scorn. She knows he has not come in peace.

decisions.choice: murderer of his master: said of Jehu, spoken to him
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "his master", as a title for the man addressed; it means Jehu, who has just killed his master Joram.

decisions.choice: your master
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "your", since Jezebel is speaking to Jehu (m3); Literal keeps "his".

decisions.choice: "Xim-ri"
decisions.reason: The king who killed his master and reigned seven days (1 Kings 16:9-20), in the usual Vietnamese form; Jezebel's taunt (m1).

decisions.choice: Jezebel taunts Jehu in the plain style, naming him "시므리"
decisions.reason: The queen mother speaks down to the rebel officer (m1, m2); "평안이냐?" keeps the wording of verses 17-22, now in mockery.

decisions.choice: Zinri, assassino do seu senhor (L, B); Zinri ... Você matou o seu senhor (R)
decisions.reason: "Zinri" is the name of 1 Kings 16:9-20 in Portuguese, the officer who "conspirou" and killed his king (m1), as Jehu has just done (verse 14). Portuguese "seu" means both "his" and "your", so Literal keeps the Hebrew's third person and still reads as said to Jehu (m3); Balanced needs no change, and the English "you Zimri" is left out, since "seu Zinri" would sound like "Mr. Zimri" in Brazil. Readable makes the taunt two short sentences.

source.text: וַיִּשָּׂ֤א פָנָיו֙ אֶל־הַ֣חַלּ֔וֹן וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מִ֥י אִתִּ֖י מִ֑י וַיַּשְׁקִ֣יפוּ אֵלָ֔יו שְׁנַ֥יִם שְׁלֹשָׁ֖ה סָרִיסִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he lifted his face to the window and said, Who [is] with me? Who? And looked down to him two [or] three eunuchs.

en.L: And he lifted his face to the window and said, "Who [is] with me? Who?" And two [or] three eunuchs looked down at him.
en.B: Jehu looked up at the window. "Who is on my side?" he called. "Who?" Two or three officials looked down at him.
en.R: Jehu looked up toward the window and shouted, "Who is with me? Who?" Two or three palace officials looked down at him.

es.L: Y él alzó su rostro hacia la ventana y dijo: «¿Quién [está] conmigo? ¿Quién?». Y se asomaron a él dos [o] tres eunucos.
es.B: Jehú miró hacia la ventana y gritó: «¿Quién está de mi parte? ¿Quién?». Dos o tres funcionarios se asomaron a mirarlo.
es.R: Jehú miró hacia la ventana y gritó: «¿Quién está conmigo? ¿Quién?». Dos o tres funcionarios del palacio se asomaron a mirarlo.

fr.L: Et il leva son visage vers la fenêtre et dit : « Qui [est] avec moi ? Qui ? » Et deux [ou] trois eunuques regardèrent vers lui.
fr.B: Jéhu leva les yeux vers la fenêtre et cria : « Qui est de mon côté ? Qui ? » Deux ou trois hauts fonctionnaires se penchèrent vers lui.
fr.R: Jéhu a levé les yeux vers la fenêtre et il a crié : « Qui est avec moi ? Qui ? » Deux ou trois fonctionnaires du palais ont regardé vers lui.

sw.L: Akainua uso wake kuelekea dirisha, akasema, "Ni nani [aliye] pamoja nami? Ni nani?" Matowashi wawili [au] watatu wakamchungulia.
sw.B: Yehu akatazama juu kuelekea dirisha, akaita, "Ni nani aliye upande wangu? Ni nani?" Maafisa wawili au watatu wakamchungulia.
sw.R: Yehu akatazama juu kuelekea dirisha, akapaza sauti, "Ni nani aliye pamoja nami? Ni nani?" Maafisa wawili au watatu wa ikulu wakamchungulia.

vi.L: Giê-hu ngước mặt lên cửa sổ và nói: "Ai theo ta? Ai?" Hai ba hoạn quan nhìn xuống ông.
vi.B: Giê-hu ngước nhìn lên cửa sổ và gọi: "Ai đứng về phía ta? Ai?" Hai ba triều thần nhìn xuống ông.
vi.R: Giê-hu ngước nhìn lên cửa sổ và la lên: "Ai theo ta? Ai?" Có hai ba quan chức trong cung nhìn xuống ông.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 창 쪽으로 얼굴을 들고 말했다. "누가 내 편이냐? 누구냐?" 그러자 내시 두세 명이 그를 내려다보았다.
ko.B: 예후가 창문을 쳐다보며 외쳤다. "누가 내 편이냐? 누구냐?" 그러자 관리 두세 명이 그를 내려다보았다.
ko.R: 예후는 창문 쪽을 올려다보며 소리쳤다. "누가 내 편이냐? 누구냐?" 그러자 궁궐 관리 두세 명이 그를 내려다보았다.

pt.L: E ele levantou o rosto para a janela e disse: "Quem [está] comigo? Quem?" E dois [ou] três eunucos olharam para ele lá de cima.
pt.B: Jeú olhou para a janela. "Quem está do meu lado?", gritou. "Quem?" Dois ou três oficiais olharam para ele lá de cima.
pt.R: Jeú olhou para a janela e gritou: "Quem está comigo? Quem?" Dois ou três oficiais do palácio olharam para ele lá de cima.

decisions.choice: eunuchs: palace officials, probably castrated servants
decisions.reason: The word can mean a castrated man or, more generally, a court official. In the women's quarters of a palace the queen's attendants were often eunuchs, and that may be the sense here (compare Esther 2:3; 4:5).

decisions.choice: who is with me? who?: who will take my side?
decisions.reason: Jehu calls for anyone in the palace willing to turn against Jezebel.

decisions.choice: eunuchs (Literal); officials (Balanced); palace officials (Readable)
decisions.reason: As settled for Samuel and Kings; the footnote gives the narrower sense (m1).

decisions.choice: eunucos (L); oficiais (B); oficiais do palácio (R)
decisions.reason: The court officials (m1) are "eunucos" at Literal, the word of Acts 8:27 in Portuguese, and "oficiais" at Balanced and Readable, as the English, which leaves the narrower sense to the note.

source.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר שִׁמְט֖וּהָ וַֽיִּשְׁמְט֑וּהָ וַיִּ֨ז מִדָּמָ֧הּ אֶל־הַקִּ֛יר וְאֶל־הַסּוּסִ֖ים וַֽיִּרְמְסֶֽנָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, Let her drop! And they let her drop, and spattered some of her blood on the wall and on the horses, and he trampled her.

en.L: And he said, "Let her drop!" And they let her drop, and some of her blood spattered on the wall and on the horses, and he trampled her.
en.B: "Throw her down!" he said. They threw her down, and some of her blood spattered on the wall and on the horses, and Jehu drove over her.
en.R: "Throw her down!" Jehu ordered. So they threw her down. Some of her blood splashed onto the wall and onto the horses, and Jehu drove his horses over her body.

es.L: Y él dijo: «¡{{plural_you:Échenla|Echadla}} abajo!». Y la echaron abajo, y salpicó de su sangre la pared y los caballos, y él la pisoteó.
es.B: «¡{{plural_you:Échenla|Echadla}} abajo!», dijo. Ellos la echaron abajo, y su sangre salpicó la pared y los caballos, y Jehú le pasó por encima.
es.R: «¡{{plural_you:Échenla|Echadla}} abajo!», ordenó Jehú. Así que la echaron abajo. Su sangre salpicó la pared y los caballos, y Jehú pasó con sus caballos por encima del cuerpo.

fr.L: Et il dit : « Laissez-la tomber ! » Et ils la laissèrent tomber, et de son sang éclaboussa le mur et les chevaux, et il la piétina.
fr.B: « Jetez-la en bas ! » dit-il. Ils la jetèrent en bas ; une partie de son sang éclaboussa le mur et les chevaux, et Jéhu passa sur elle.
fr.R: « Jetez-la en bas ! » a ordonné Jéhu. Alors ils l’ont jetée en bas. Une partie de son sang a éclaboussé le mur et les chevaux, et Jéhu a fait passer ses chevaux sur son corps.

sw.L: Akasema, "Mwangusheni!" Wakamwangusha, na baadhi ya damu yake ikarukia ukutani na juu ya farasi, naye akamkanyaga.
sw.B: Akasema, "Mtupeni chini!" Wakamtupa chini, na baadhi ya damu yake ikarukia ukutani na juu ya farasi, naye Yehu akapitisha gari juu yake.
sw.R: Yehu akaamuru, "Mtupeni chini!" Basi wakamtupa chini. Baadhi ya damu yake ikarukia ukutani na juu ya farasi, naye Yehu akapitisha farasi wake juu ya mwili wake.

vi.L: Ông nói: "Hãy quăng bà ta xuống!" Họ quăng bà ta xuống, và máu bà ta văng lên tường và lên ngựa, và ông giày đạp bà ta.
vi.B: Giê-hu nói: "Quăng bà ta xuống!" Họ quăng bà ta xuống, máu bà ta văng lên tường và lên ngựa, và Giê-hu cho xe cán qua bà ta.
vi.R: Giê-hu ra lệnh: "Quăng bà ta xuống!" Vậy họ quăng bà ta xuống. Máu bà ta văng lên tường và lên mình ngựa, và Giê-hu cho ngựa giẫm lên xác bà ta.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 말했다. "그 여자를 떨어뜨려라!" 그러자 그들이 그를 떨어뜨렸고, 그의 피가 벽과 말들에 튀었다. 그리고 그가 그를 짓밟았다.
ko.B: 예후가 말했다. "그 여자를 내던져라!" 그들이 그 여자를 내던지자, 그 피가 벽과 말들에 튀었다. 예후는 병거를 몰아 그 여자를 짓밟았다.
ko.R: 예후가 명령했다. "그 여자를 밑으로 던져라!" 그러자 그들이 이세벨을 던졌다. 그 피가 벽과 말들에 튀었다. 예후는 말을 몰아 이세벨의 몸을 짓밟고 지나갔다.

pt.L: E ele disse: "Deixem-na cair!" E a deixaram cair, e parte do sangue dela respingou na parede e nos cavalos, e ele a pisoteou.
pt.B: "Joguem-na para baixo!", ele disse. Eles a jogaram, e parte do sangue dela respingou na parede e nos cavalos, e Jeú passou por cima dela.
pt.R: "Joguem essa mulher para baixo!", ordenou Jeú. Então eles a jogaram. Um pouco do sangue dela espirrou na parede e nos cavalos, e Jeú passou com os cavalos por cima do corpo dela.

decisions.choice: let her drop: throw her down
decisions.reason: The verb means to let fall or release; the officials threw her from the window.

decisions.choice: he trampled her: Jehu drove his horses and chariot over her
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "he", meaning Jehu, whose horses and chariot went over her body. Some ancient translations read "they trampled her", meaning the horses.

decisions.choice: Jehu drove over her (Balanced); drove his horses over her body (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Jehu and say how he trampled her (m2).

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֖א וַיֹּ֣אכַל וַיֵּ֑שְׁתְּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר פִּקְדוּ־נָ֞א אֶת־הָאֲרוּרָ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ וְקִבְר֔וּהָ כִּ֥י בַת־מֶ֖לֶךְ הִֽיא׃

records.literal_gloss: And he went in and ate and drank, and he said, Attend please to the cursed [woman] this, and bury her, for daughter of a king she [is].

en.L: And he went in and ate and drank, and he said, "Please attend to this cursed [woman] and bury her, for she [is] a king's daughter."
en.B: Then Jehu went in and ate and drank. He said, "See to this cursed woman and bury her, for she was a king's daughter."
en.R: Then Jehu went into the palace and had something to eat and drink. Later he said, "Take care of that cursed woman and bury her. After all, she was a king's daughter."

es.L: Y entró y comió y bebió, y dijo: «{{plural_you:Ocúpense|Ocupaos}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} ruego, de esta maldita y {{plural_you:sepúltenla|sepultadla}}, porque es hija de rey».
es.B: Luego Jehú entró, comió y bebió. Y dijo: «{{plural_you:Ocúpense|Ocupaos}} de esa maldita y {{plural_you:sepúltenla|sepultadla}}, porque era hija de rey».
es.R: Luego Jehú entró en el palacio y comió y bebió algo. Más tarde dijo: «{{plural_you:Encárguense|Encargaos}} de esa maldita y {{plural_you:sepúltenla|sepultadla}}. Al fin y al cabo, era hija de rey».

fr.L: Et il entra, mangea et but, et il dit : « Occupez-vous donc de cette maudite et enterrez-la, car elle [est] fille de roi. »
fr.B: Puis Jéhu entra, mangea et but. Il dit : « Occupez-vous de cette maudite et enterrez-la, car c’était une fille de roi. »
fr.R: Ensuite Jéhu est entré dans le palais, et il a mangé et bu. Plus tard, il a dit : « Occupez-vous de cette maudite femme et enterrez-la. Après tout, c’était une fille de roi. »

sw.L: Akaingia, akala, akanywa, akasema, "Tafadhali mshughulikieni [mwanamke] huyu aliyelaaniwa, mkamzike, kwa maana yeye [ni] binti mfalme."
sw.B: Kisha Yehu akaingia, akala na kunywa. Akasema, "Mshughulikieni mwanamke huyu aliyelaaniwa mkamzike, kwa maana alikuwa binti mfalme."
sw.R: Kisha Yehu akaingia ikulu, akala na kunywa. Baadaye akasema, "Mshughulikieni yule mwanamke aliyelaaniwa, mkamzike. Hata hivyo, alikuwa binti mfalme."

vi.L: Ông đi vào ăn uống, rồi nói: "Hãy lo cho người đàn bà bị nguyền rủa này và chôn bà ta đi, vì bà ta là con gái vua."
vi.B: Rồi Giê-hu đi vào ăn uống. Ông nói: "Hãy lo cho người đàn bà bị nguyền rủa ấy và chôn bà ta đi, vì dù sao bà ta cũng là con gái của một vua."
vi.R: Rồi Giê-hu vào cung ăn uống. Sau đó ông nói: "Hãy lo cho người đàn bà bị nguyền rủa ấy và chôn bà ta đi. Dù sao bà ta cũng là con gái của một vua."

ko.L: 그리고 그가 들어가서 먹고 마셨다. 그리고 그가 말했다. "이 저주받은 [여자를] 살펴서 묻어 주어라. 그는 왕의 딸이다."
ko.B: 예후는 들어가서 먹고 마셨다. 그리고 말했다. "저 저주받은 여자를 거두어 묻어 주어라. 그래도 왕의 딸이었다."
ko.R: 예후는 궁궐로 들어가서 먹고 마셨다. 나중에 그가 말했다. "그 저주받은 여자를 거두어 묻어 주어라. 그래도 그 여자는 왕의 딸이었다."

pt.L: E ele entrou, e comeu e bebeu, e disse: "Cuidem, por favor, dessa amaldiçoada e sepultem-na, porque ela [é] filha de rei."
pt.B: Depois Jeú entrou, comeu e bebeu. Então disse: "Cuidem dessa mulher amaldiçoada e sepultem-na, pois ela era filha de rei."
pt.R: Depois Jeú entrou no palácio, comeu e bebeu alguma coisa. Mais tarde ele disse: "Cuidem daquela mulher amaldiçoada e sepultem o corpo dela. Afinal, ela era filha de rei."

decisions.choice: this cursed woman: under Yahweh's curse
decisions.reason: The word means one on whom a curse rests. Jezebel had fallen under the curse Elijah spoke (1 Kings 21:23).

decisions.choice: a king's daughter: born to royalty
decisions.reason: Jezebel was the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians (1 Kings 16:31). Jehu means to give her the burial due to royal birth, but it is already too late (verses 35-37).

decisions.choice: he went in and ate and drank: Jehu takes possession of the palace
decisions.reason: Jehu enters the royal house and eats there as its new master, while Jezebel's body lies outside.

decisions.choice: into the palace; Later
decisions.reason: Readable says where Jehu went and that the order came after the meal.

decisions.choice: the narrator and Jehu speak of Jezebel as "bà ta"
decisions.reason: The queen is condemned, but the narrative does not insult her; "bà ta" keeps the distance without contempt.

decisions.choice: amaldiçoada
decisions.reason: The woman under the curse (m1) is "amaldiçoada", the participle of "amaldiçoar", the Old Testament terms' verb for cursing, so the reader can link it with the curse Elijah spoke; "maldita" would sound like a modern insult.

source.text: וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ לְקָבְרָ֑הּ וְלֹא־מָ֣צְאוּ בָ֗הּ כִּ֧י אִם־הַגֻּלְגֹּ֛לֶת וְהָרַגְלַ֖יִם וְכַפּ֥וֹת הַיָּדָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they went to bury her, and not they found of her except the skull and the feet and the palms of the hands.

en.L: And they went to bury her, but they did not find [anything] of her except the skull and the feet and the palms of the hands.
en.B: But when they went to bury her, they found nothing of her except her skull, her feet and the palms of her hands.
en.R: But when the men went to bury her, all they found was her skull, her feet and her hands.

es.L: Y fueron a sepultarla, pero no hallaron de ella más que el cráneo, los pies y las palmas de las manos.
es.B: Pero cuando fueron a sepultarla, no encontraron de ella más que el cráneo, los pies y las palmas de las manos.
es.R: Pero cuando los hombres fueron a sepultarla, solo encontraron el cráneo, los pies y las manos.

fr.L: Et ils allèrent pour l’enterrer, mais ils ne trouvèrent d’elle que le crâne, les pieds et les paumes des mains.
fr.B: Mais quand ils allèrent l’enterrer, ils ne trouvèrent d’elle que le crâne, les pieds et les paumes des mains.
fr.R: Mais quand les hommes sont allés l’enterrer, ils ont seulement trouvé son crâne, ses pieds et ses mains.

sw.L: Wakaenda kumzika, lakini hawakuona [kitu] chake ila fuvu la kichwa, na miguu, na viganja vya mikono.
sw.B: Lakini walipokwenda kumzika, hawakuona kitu chake isipokuwa fuvu la kichwa, miguu yake na viganja vya mikono yake.
sw.R: Lakini watu walipokwenda kumzika, walikuta fuvu la kichwa chake tu, miguu yake na mikono yake.

vi.L: Họ đi chôn bà ta, nhưng không tìm thấy gì của bà ta ngoài cái sọ, hai bàn chân và hai lòng bàn tay.
vi.B: Nhưng khi họ đi chôn bà ta, họ không tìm thấy gì ngoài cái sọ, hai bàn chân và hai lòng bàn tay của bà ta.
vi.R: Nhưng khi người ta đi chôn bà ta, họ chỉ tìm thấy cái sọ, hai bàn chân và hai bàn tay của bà ta.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그를 묻으러 갔으나, 두개골과 발과 손바닥 말고는 그에게서 아무것도 찾지 못했다.
ko.B: 그러나 사람들이 그 여자를 묻으러 가 보니, 두개골과 두 발과 두 손바닥밖에 남아 있지 않았다.

records.literal_gloss: And they returned and told him, and he said, [The] word of Yahweh it [is] which he spoke by [the] hand of his slave Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In [the] plot of Jezreel will eat the dogs [the] flesh of Jezebel;

en.L: And they returned and told him, and he said, "This is the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke by the hand of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} slave Elijah the Tishbite, saying, 'In the plot of ground of Jezreel the dogs will eat the flesh of Jezebel;
en.B: They went back and told Jehu, and he said, "This is the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant Elijah the Tishbite: 'The dogs will eat the flesh of Jezebel on the plot of ground at Jezreel,
en.R: They went back and told Jehu. He said, "This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said would happen. He spoke through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant Elijah from Tishbe and said, 'Dogs will eat Jezebel's body on the land at Jezreel.

es.L: Y volvieron y se lo contaron, y él dijo: «Es la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} habló por mano de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo Elías el tisbita, diciendo: “En la parcela de Jezreel comerán los perros la carne de Jezabel;
es.B: Volvieron y se lo contaron a Jehú, y él dijo: «Esta es la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} anunció por medio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo Elías el tisbita: “Los perros comerán la carne de Jezabel en la parcela de Jezreel,
es.R: Volvieron y se lo contaron a Jehú. Él dijo: «Esto es lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo que pasaría. Habló por medio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo Elías, el de Tisbe, y dijo: “Los perros se comerán el cuerpo de Jezabel en el campo de Jezreel.

fr.L: Et ils revinrent le lui rapporter, et il dit : « C’est la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a prononcée par la main de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} esclave Élie le Tishbite, en disant : “Dans le champ de Jizreël, les chiens mangeront la chair de Jézabel ;
fr.B: Ils revinrent le dire à Jéhu, qui déclara : « C’est la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a prononcée par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur Élie le Tishbite : “Les chiens mangeront la chair de Jézabel dans le champ de Jizreël,
fr.R: Ils sont revenus le dire à Jéhu. Il a dit : « C’est ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait annoncé. Il a parlé par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur Élie, de Tishbé, et il a dit : “Des chiens mangeront le corps de Jézabel sur la terre de Jizreël.

sw.B: Wakarudi, wakamweleza Yehu, naye akasema, "Hili ni neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilolisema kupitia mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Eliya Mtishbi: 'Mbwa watakula nyama ya Yezebeli katika kiwanja cha Yezreeli,
sw.R: Wakarudi, wakamweleza Yehu. Akasema, "Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilosema lingetokea. Alisema kupitia mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Eliya wa Tishbi, akasema, 'Mbwa watakula mwili wa Yezebeli katika ardhi ya Yezreeli.

vi.L: Họ trở về báo cho ông, và ông nói: "Đây là lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán qua tay đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Ê-li người Thi-sê-be rằng: 'Tại thửa đất Gít-rê-ên chó sẽ ăn thịt Giê-sa-bên;
vi.B: Họ trở về báo cho Giê-hu, và ông nói: "Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán qua đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Ê-li người Thi-sê-be: 'Chó sẽ ăn thịt Giê-sa-bên tại thửa đất ở Gít-rê-ên,
vi.R: Họ trở về báo cho Giê-hu. Ông nói: "Đây là điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán sẽ xảy ra. Ngài đã phán qua đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Ê-li người Thi-sê-be: 'Chó sẽ ăn xác Giê-sa-bên tại khu đất ở Gít-rê-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 돌아와서 그에게 알렸다. 그러자 그가 말했다. "이것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그의 종 디셉 사람 엘리야의 손으로 하신 말씀이다. '이스르엘 땅에서 개들이 이세벨의 살을 먹을 것이다.
ko.B: 그들이 돌아와서 예후에게 알리자, 그가 말했다. "이것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 종 디셉 사람 엘리야를 통해 하신 말씀대로이다. '이스르엘 땅에서 개들이 이세벨의 살을 먹을 것이다.
ko.R: 그들이 돌아와서 예후에게 알렸다. 예후가 말했다. "이것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 그대로이다. 주께서는 그분의 종인 디셉 사람 엘리야를 통해 말씀하셨다. '개들이 이스르엘 땅에서 이세벨의 몸을 먹을 것이다.

pt.L: E voltaram e lhe contaram, e ele disse: "Esta [é] a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} falou pela mão do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} escravo Elias, o tisbita, dizendo: 'No terreno de Jezreel os cães comerão a carne de Jezabel;
pt.B: Eles voltaram e contaram a Jeú, e ele disse: "Esta é a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} falou por meio do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} servo Elias, o tisbita: 'Os cães comerão a carne de Jezabel no terreno de Jezreel,
pt.R: Eles voltaram e contaram tudo a Jeú. Ele disse: "Foi isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse que ia acontecer. Ele falou por meio do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} servo Elias, o tisbita, e disse: 'Os cães comerão o corpo de Jezabel nas terras de Jezreel.

decisions.choice: the word of Yahweh spoken by Elijah: fulfilled
decisions.reason: Elijah had said, "The dogs will eat Jezebel by the rampart of Jezreel" (1 Kings 21:23). Jehu quotes the word in a form close to verse 10, with "plot of ground" and "flesh".

decisions.choice: by the hand of his servant: through his servant
decisions.reason: "By the hand of" means through someone, as the one who carries the message (1 Kings 14:18; 16:7).

decisions.choice: the Tishbite: from Tishbe
decisions.reason: Elijah came from Tishbe in Gilead (1 Kings 17:1).

decisions.choice: slave (Literal); servant (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 7.

decisions.choice: Dogs will eat Jezebel's body on the land at Jezreel.
decisions.reason: Readable ends the sentence here and starts verse 37 as a new sentence, inside the same quotation.

decisions.choice: "엘리야의 손으로" at Literal; "엘리야를 통해" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "by the hand of", which the meaning decision explains (m2).

decisions.choice: Verse 36 ends with a full stop at every level; verse 37 is a second sentence inside the same quotation
alternatives: an open clause running into verse 37, as the English Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: Korean puts the verb at the end of each clause, so "the dogs will eat" closes verse 36; joining the verses would move words across the verse break.

decisions.choice: pela mão do seu escravo (L); por meio do seu servo (B, R); Elias, o tisbita
decisions.reason: "By the hand of" (m2) is kept at Literal, as 1 Kings 15:29 does in Portuguese, and is "por meio de" at Balanced and Readable; the prophet is "escravo" at Literal and "servo" at Balanced and Readable, as verse 7. "Elias, o tisbita" as 1 Kings 17:1 sets it for the book, Readable included. The quoted word repeats verse 10 in Portuguese, with "carne" (L, B) and "corpo" (R) for "flesh".

ko.L: 그리고 이세벨의 시체는 이스르엘 땅에서 밭 위의 거름처럼 될 것이니, 그들이 '이것이 이세벨이다' 하고 말하지 못할 것이다.'"
ko.B: 이세벨의 시체는 이스르엘 땅 들판 위에 거름처럼 흩어져서, 아무도 '이것이 이세벨이다' 하고 말할 수 없을 것이다.'"

pt.L: e o cadáver de Jezabel será como esterco sobre a face do campo, no terreno de Jezreel, de modo que não dirão: "Esta [é] Jezabel."'"
pt.B: e o cadáver de Jezabel será como esterco espalhado sobre o campo, no terreno de Jezreel, de modo que ninguém poderá dizer: "Esta é Jezabel."'"
pt.R: O corpo dela vai ficar como esterco espalhado num campo em Jezreel, de modo que ninguém vai poder dizer: "Esta é Jezabel."'"

decisions.choice: like dung on the face of the field: left unburied and despised
decisions.reason: The picture of corpses lying like manure on the ground is used by the prophets for those who die under judgment and are not buried or mourned (Jeremiah 8:2; 9:21; 16:4; Psalm 83:11). Elijah's words in 1 Kings 21:23 are given more fully here.

decisions.choice: so that they will not say, This is Jezebel: no grave or body will remain
decisions.reason: Nothing will be left to mark her, no tomb and no body to name. The proud queen will vanish without a memorial.

decisions.choice: will be: the form read aloud
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) have an older spelling of this verb; the form marked to be read aloud (qere) is the usual one. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: manure spread on a field
decisions.reason: Readable uses a plain word for dung and says how it lies on a field.

decisions.choice: The innermost quotation uses single quotes inside Elijah's words
decisions.reason: Korean typography marks a quotation within a quotation with single quotes; the English's third level is not needed, since "하고 말하다" marks it.

decisions.choice: o cadáver (L, B), o corpo (R); esterco
decisions.reason: "Esterco" is the word 1 Kings 14:10 uses for dung in Portuguese, at every level, since it is the plain word (m1); Readable adds "espalhado num campo", as the English does.
